respins.how_it_works:
The Zephyr Crest symbol activates when at least one Wild Spirit and one Zephyr Crest symbol appear on the grid at the same time. Once activated, the Zephyr Crest symbol expands all Spirit symbols on the grid, even if they are not part of a win. The Zephyr Crest symbol nudges all Wild Spirit symbols one reel to the left, awards a Respin, and applies a new Multiplier value to each Wild Spirit on the grid.

 Wild Spirits cannot be nudged off the grid. They will be nudged to the leftmost reel that is not already occupied by a Wild Spirit. Wild Spirits on the leftmost reel will remain in place and receive a new Multiplier during the Respin. New Spirits and Zephyr Crest symbols can land during the Respins, triggering more Wild Spirits and nudges. Only one Zephyr Crest symbol can land on the grid at a time.

wilds.name: EXPANDED WILD SPIRITS
wilds.behavior:
When a Spirit symbol lands, it expands into a Wild Spirit if the expanded symbol is a part of at least one winning combination once expanded.

 Spirit symbols only expand upward, to the top of the grid. Spirit symbols that land on the top row will still be counted as expanded Wild Spirits if part of a win. Expanded Wild Spirits count as Wilds on every position the expanded symbol covers. Only one Spirit symbol can land on a reel at a time.

 When a Wild Spirit expands it reveals a Multiplier which is applied to the entire Wild Spirit. If a winning combination includes more than one Multiplier, the Multiplier values will be added together and then applied to the win. Multipliers can have the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x

wilds.name: ZEPHYR CREST SYMBOLS
wilds.behavior:
The Zephyr Crest symbol activates when at least one Wild Spirit and one Zephyr Crest symbol appear on the grid at the same time. Once activated, the Zephyr Crest symbol expands all Spirit symbols on the grid, even if they are not part of a win. The Zephyr Crest symbol nudges all Wild Spirit symbols one reel to the left, awards a Respin, and applies a new Multiplier value to each Wild Spirit on the grid.

 Wild Spirits cannot be nudged off the grid. They will be nudged to the leftmost reel that is not already occupied by a Wild Spirit. Wild Spirits on the leftmost reel will remain in place and receive a new Multiplier during the Respin. New Spirits and Zephyr Crest symbols can land during the Respins, triggering more Wild Spirits and nudges. Only one Zephyr Crest symbol can land on the grid at a time.

 This Hidden Epic Bonus keeps the mechanics of the WHISPERING WINDS bonus. In addition, each spin guarantees at least 2 Wild Spirits!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins,

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

respins.how_it_works:
Landing the golden S’n’S scatter symbol activates the Stack’n’Sync™ feature and guarantees that all 5 reels are stacked. Only high-paying symbols and the Wild symbol can be stacked by the golden S’n’S.

 The golden S’n’S also activates a global multiplier that is applied to any wins on the respin. The multiplier is shown in the upper left corner above the reels.

 The multiplier can have one of the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x

wilds.name: STACK’N’SYNC™
wilds.behavior:
Landing the S’n’S scatter symbol activates the Stack’n’Sync™ feature.

 The reel where the symbol landed is copied to up to 4 other reels and these reels are then stacked with one kind of symbol. The stacked symbols replace existing symbols on the reels. The game then awards a respin, with the stacked reels synced to each other so they stop in the same position.

 Landing another S’n’S symbol during the respin will repeat the stacking on additional reels and sync them, and award an additional respin.

 The stacked symbol and the stack amount is shown by the symbol and stars that appear in the upper right corner above the reels. Each filled star represents one quarter of the reels. Reels can be a quarter, half, three-quarters or fully stacked!

 All regular paying symbols, the Wild symbol, and the FS symbol can be stacked. The Eagle Claw bonus symbol can not be stacked.

wilds.name: EAGLE LINK
wilds.behavior:
Trigger the Eagle Link bonus by landing 3 Eagle Claw scatter symbols simultaneously in the base game.

 This bonus has two phases: a collect phase and a payout phase. Only Eagle symbols, Golden Eagle symbols and non-paying symbols appear in this bonus.

 During the collect phase all landed Eagle and Golden Eagle symbols are sticky. The collect phase has 3 spins that refill when a new Eagle or Golden Eagle sticks. After 3 spins in a row without sticking new symbols, the collect phase ends and the bonus transitions to the payout phase. No wins are awarded during the collect phase.

 Every landed Golden Eagle symbol activates the Eagle Link feature. The Eagle Link connects to all Eagle symbols that land vertically or horizontally adjacent to a Golden Eagle or another Eagle symbol already connected to the Eagle Link. When the collect phase ends, all Eagle symbols that are not connected to the Eagle Link are removed.

 The following symbols are non-paying:

 The payout phase initially awards 3 spins. Golden Eagle symbols are sticky and each that lands during this phase awards 1 additional spin.

 The payout phase has a global multiplier that applies to all Eagle symbol wins. The multiplier value is equal to the number of stuck Golden Eagle symbols.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all other symbols in the paytable.

 The Golden Eagle symbol appears only in the Eagle Link bonus game and substitutes for Eagle symbols when calculating wins.

 The Eagle Claw symbol appears only in the base game.

 The FS symbol appears only in the base game.

The Pistol Cylinder will activate after all wins and cascades have been settled. When the Pistol Cylinder fires, it will hit as many symbols on the grid as there are shots in the Pistol Cylinder. If there is more than one Pistol Cylinder on the grid, they will activate in order, from top to bottom, left to right. Pistol Cylinders can shoot the same position more than once. Once the Wild symbol has transformed into a Pistol Cylinder, it is no longer Wild.

 The symbols that the Pistol Cylinder hits reveal Special symbols: Coins, Amulets, Sacred Relic, and Reload symbols. After all shots are fired, if a Reload symbol appears on the grid, it will activate and reload all the Pistol Cylinders with between 2-6 shots, revealing new Special symbols. cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
When a Cash symbol lands, it will activate and expand from that symbol upwards to the top of the reel after all wins and cascades have been handled on that spin.

 When a Cash symbol expands, it turns into a Cash Stack. Cash symbols that land on the top row are counted as Cash Stacks. Each position on the grid that the Cash Stack covers will reveal 1 of the following bet Multipliers: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 500x, 1 000x, 5 000x, 10 000x. Once expanded, the Cash Stack Multiplier values will be added and multiplied by the current bet amount to determine the awarded win. If there is more than 1 Cash Stack on the grid, the Multipliers will first be added, then multiplied by the current bet amount to determine the awarded win. Only 1 Cash Stack can land on a reel at a time.

scatters.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - REACTOR RIOT
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game keeps the mechanics of the BROS BEFORE BLOWS bonus. In addition, this bonus guarantees 1 bash from Oskar and 1 smash from Fred on each free spin! If there are already Cash Stacks on every reel, only Fred will activate and smash the Cash Stacks. The order of the bash and smash activation may vary.

 FS symbols cannot land in the REACTOR RIOT bonus.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 FS symbols cannot land above a Cash symbol on the same reel.

multipliers.name: CASH STACKS
multipliers.behavior:
When a Cash symbol lands, it will activate and expand from that symbol upwards to the top of the reel after all wins and cascades have been handled on that spin.

 When a Cash symbol expands, it turns into a Cash Stack. Cash symbols that land on the top row are counted as Cash Stacks. Each position on the grid that the Cash Stack covers will reveal 1 of the following bet Multipliers: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 500x, 1 000x, 5 000x, 10 000x. Once expanded, the Cash Stack Multiplier values will be added and multiplied by the current bet amount to determine the awarded win. If there is more than 1 Cash Stack on the grid, the Multipliers will first be added, then multiplied by the current bet amount to determine the awarded win. Only 1 Cash Stack can land on a reel at a time.

multipliers.name: THE BASHING BROS
multipliers.behavior:
When the current grid has settled, and there is a Cash Stack on the grid, there is a chance that Oskar, on the left side, will activate and bash the grid, or Fred, on the right side, will activate and smash the grid. When Oskar bashes the grid, between 1- 4 regular symbols will be removed from 1 random reel that does not already contain a Cash Stack. A Cash symbol will then be added to the first empty position at the lowest part of the empty reel and expand into a Cash Stack, revealing new Multiplier values

 When Fred smashes the grid, all the Cash Stacks on the grid will be compressed down towards their original Cash symbol. When the Cash Stack is compressed, 1 more Multiplier is added to every position the Cash Stack covers. The Multiplier on each new position will be the same as the previous Multipliers that already existed on those positions. If the Cash Stack values were 2x, 5x, 3x, it will become 2x, 5x, 3x, 2x, 5x, 3x.

 When Oskar activates first and bashes the grid, followed by Fred smashing it, the new Cash Stacks created by Oskar will also be compressed and receive double the Multiplier values. Oskar and Fred can each activate once per spin. If there are already Cash Stacks on every reel, only Fred will activate and bash the Cash Stacks. Cash Stacks are removed from the grid before the next spin.

scatters.name: BOOK OF STACKWAYS™
scatters.behavior:
Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate this bonus game with 10 free spins.

 At the beginning of the bonus game, 2 paying symbols are randomly chosen to be the Special symbols. When one of the Special symbols lands on at least 3 reels at the same time, indicators below the corresponding reels will light up to reveal a number from 2 - 10. Those reels will then be stacked with the shown amount of the winning symbol.

 Stacked symbols pay as if the stacked reels were connected from left to right.

 If more than one Special symbol type lands on 3 or more reels at the same time, they will stack and pay one type at a time.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time during the feature awards additional free spins:

 2 FS symbols awards 2 extra spins.

 3 FS symbols awards 4 extra spins. 

 Landing 4 FS symbols at the same time upgrades the feature to SUPER BOOK OF STACKWAYS™ and awards 4 extra spins.

scatters.name: SUPER BOOK OF STACKWAYS™
scatters.behavior:
Land 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate this bonus feature with 10 free spins.

 At the beginning of the bonus game, 4 paying symbols are randomly chosen to be the Special symbols. When one of the Special symbols lands on at least 3 reels at the same time, indicators below the corresponding reels will light up to reveal a number from 2 - 10. The revealed value corresponds to the number of stacks that will be added to the reel above the number.

 When the symbol has been stacked in this way, they will pay as if all reels were counted sequentially from left to right.

 If more than one Special symbol lands on 3 or more reels, they will stack and pay one at a time.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time during the feature awards additional free spins:

 2 FS symbols awards 2 extra spins.

 3 FS symbols awards 4 extra spins.

specials.name: STACKWAYS™
specials.behavior:
Land Stackways™ symbols on a reel to fill that reel with a stack of paying symbols. Between 2 to 10 symbols can be stacked on each reel.

 There are two types of Stackways™ symbols:

 Normal Stackways™ symbols with the possible values: 2, 3, 4

 Revealing Stackways™ symbols with the possible values: 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10

 The stacked symbol is determined by choosing the symbol that would grant the longest winning combination among the symbols present on the reels when the Stackways™ symbol activates. If more than one winning combination of equal length could be created, the symbol will be chosen randomly from among the symbols that could create those winning combinations. The stacking only occurs when the result would create a winning combination.

wilds.behavior:
Land 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate this bonus, which awards 10 free spins.

 At the start of the bonus, one of the four high-paying symbols will be selected as the main symbol for the bonus feature. The selected main symbol is the only symbol that can expand into Monster Reels during the bonus.

wilds.name: MULTIPLIER PAIRS
wilds.behavior:
Multiplier symbols consist of a left half with an “x” and a right half with a number. When a complete Multiplier Pair lands, it acts as a Global Multiplier, applying to all wins on that spin. If more than one Multiplier Pair lands, their values will be multiplied before being applied to all wins. Possible Multiplier Pair values are x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x15, x20.

 Wild symbols appear as half symbols. Landed Wilds will convert to a matching half to form a winning pair with paying symbols. The Wild symbol cannot form a winning Pair with an FS half or a Multiplier half.

wilds.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - HELL’S HAPPY HOUR
wilds.behavior:

FS and Multipliers in the Bash Bar will activate first, followed by the remaining symbols left to right. Multipliers revealed in the Bash Bar will only be applied to Bash Bar wins. Wild symbols in the Bash Bar will convert symbols in that reel to Wild.

 Landing additional FS Pairs in the bonus awards 2 extra free spins per pair.

This means, for example, that a match cannot occur between reels 2 and 3.

modes.name: BONUS GAME -TOP-SHELF TROUBLE
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 2 FS Pairs during the base game.

 This bonus game has a Bash Bar added as an extra row at the top of the grid. After each spin, once all regular wins are collected, the Bash Bar reveals a symbol for each reel from left to right. The revealed symbol can be either a dead symbol or a paying symbol. Dead symbols are non-paying and have no other effect.

 When a paying symbol is revealed and a matching half of the same symbol is present in the connected reel, the revealed symbol will convert its matching position into the same symbol, creating a winning Pair. For example, if a red low-paying symbol is revealed on reel 1’s Bash Bar and reel 2 contains one or more red low-paying symbols, the matching positions on reel 1 will be converted to red low-paying symbols to create winning Pairs. Bash Bar wins cannot occur on previous winning positions on the same spin.

 Symbols converted by the Bash Bar revert to their original state once they form a win, allowing the possibility of two separate wins on the same positions. Special Symbols; Wild, FS, and Multipliers cannot land in the Bash Bar during this bonus. Active Global Multipliers will appear outside the grid.

 Landing additional FS Pairs in the bonus awards 2 extra free spins per pair.

Bash Bar wins cannot occur on previous winning positions on the same spin.

 Symbols converted by the Bash Bar revert to their original state once they form a win, allowing the possibility of two separate wins on the same positions. Special Symbols; Wild, FS, and Multipliers cannot land in the Bash Bar during this bonus. Active Global Multipliers will appear outside the grid.

 Landing additional FS Pairs in the bonus awards 2 extra free spins per pair.

features.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - HELL’S HAPPY HOUR

FS and Multipliers in the Bash Bar will activate first, followed by the remaining symbols left to right. Multipliers revealed in the Bash Bar will only be applied to Bash Bar wins. Wild symbols in the Bash Bar will convert symbols in that reel to Wild.

 Landing additional FS Pairs in the bonus awards 2 extra free spins per pair.

Land Stack’n’Sync™ scatter symbols to stack any paying symbol on the reels. A stack of 60 symbols fills the whole reel! Fill an entire reel with the same symbol and sync all reels for massive wins!

 The first time in a round that one or more Stack’n’Sync™ symbols land, the reels where they land will be filled with a stack of 15, 30, 45 or 60 symbols of one kind.
Only 1 Stack’n’Sync™ symbol can land on each reel in a round.

For each Stack’n’Sync™ symbol that lands 1 respin is awarded. If additional Stack’n’Sync™ symbols land during the respins, those reels are synced to the already stacked reels which copies the symbols from the stacked reel and makes the reels stop in the same position.

wilds.name: It's a Classic!
wilds.behavior:
This feature is triggered by landing 3, 4 or 5 Book scatter symbols in the base game. When the feature is activated, 1 or more symbols are selected as the special symbol for the duration of the feature.

 Landing 3 Book symbols awards 10 free spins and 1 special symbol.
Landing 4 Book symbols awards 15 free spins and 2 special symbols.
Landing 5 Book symbols awards 20 free spins and 3 special symbols.

 Only Low or High paying symbols can be selected as special symbols. The Book symbol cannot be selected. Selected symbols are displayed with a golden frame and color change. See paytable for illustration.

 If the special symbols land anywhere on at least 3 reels they will spread to cover the reels that they landed on after all normal wins are awarded. After spreading, special symbols pay anywhere and can form paylines even if there are other symbols between them. If more than one special symbol lands on 3 reels during the same spin, they spread and create wins one at a time. The Book symbol does not count as a Wild symbol during this stage and cannot be a part of special symbol paylines that pay anywhere.

 Landing 3 Book symbols during the feature awards 5 extra spins and selects 1 additional special symbol. This can occur only until the special symbol bar above the grid is filled, after which no further retriggers are awarded.

wilds.name: What Time Is It?
wilds.behavior:

 When a Clock Activator scatter symbol lands on reels 2, 3 or 4, wild Multiplier Clock symbols spread from the top of the reel and replace all symbols from the top to the Clock Activator symbol. The value of the wild multipliers on each reel will be determined by the time shown on the clock at the top of that reel!

 If more than one Multiplier Clock is part of a winning line, their multiplier values are first added together and then applied to the win.

 Multiplier Clocks can have the following values: WILD, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 11x, 12x

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Book symbol is wild and substitutes for all paying symbols.
The Book symbol does not appear in the What Time Is It? game mode.
The Clock Man symbol only appears in the base game.

FEATURES

 It's a Classic!

 This feature is triggered by landing 3, 4 or 5 Book scatter symbols in the base game. When the feature is activated, 1 or more symbols are selected as the special symbol for the duration of the feature.

 Landing 3 Book symbols awards 10 free spins and 1 special symbol.
Landing 4 Book symbols awards 15 free spins and 2 special symbols.
Landing 5 Book symbols awards 20 free spins and 3 special symbols.

WAYS TO WIN

scatters.name: BONUS WHEEL
scatters.behavior:
If 3 BONUS symbols land on the grid, the bonus game feature is triggered.
The bonus game consists of a bonus wheel with 8 sections. The player gets up to 50 spins.
Every time that the hit marker comes to a stop at a particular section of the wheel, the displayed multiplier is added to the total and the multiplier on that section is increased to the next level. All multipliers start at 1x and can increase to 10x, 25x, 100x and finally 250x.

The bonus feature stops once the wheel comes to a stop on the skull symbol. The total win will be calculated as the displayed total multiplier multiplied with the base game bet level.

specials.name: COMPASS SYMBOL
specials.behavior: Five compass symbols trigger the compass in the logo. The needle starts to spin and once it stops all compass symbols multiply and spread in the direction shown. Regular wins are awarded before the compass feature is triggered.

This feature has added compass symbols on the reels. After the compass stops spinning, the compass symbol will multiply and spread in the direction shown. Regular wins are awarded before the compass feature is triggered.

3 FREE SPINS symbols award 10 free spins

WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 19. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

wilds.name: MULTIPLIERS GONE WILD
wilds.behavior:
Multiplier symbols are Wild and substitute for any symbol in the paytable. They also multiply the value of all Cash symbols in a 3x3 area around them if you land a Grab’em symbol!

 Multiplier values are applied to any winning payline they are part of. If more than one Multiplier is part of the same payline, their values are multiplied by each other before being applied to the payline.

 The possible Multiplier values are: x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, x10, x15, x20, x25.

 Multiplier symbols with a value of x5 or higher land with a ? and reveal their value when Cash is collected.

scatters.name: CASH MONEY
scatters.behavior:
Land, collect, multiply!

 Cash symbols award a prize when collected! Cash symbols can display a value from one of the following: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x.

 Cash symbols are collected if a Grab’em scatter symbol appears at the same time as at least one Cash symbol.

 Multiplier symbols affect all collected Cash in a 3x3 area around the symbol. If more than one Multiplier lands adjacent to a Cash symbol, the Cash value is multiplied by each adjacent Multiplier symbol.

scatters.name: THE VAULT
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus feature with 6 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus feature offers an enhanced base game experience, with better odds of landing a greater number of Cash and Multiplier symbols with higher values!

 On top of that, all landed Multiplier symbol positions are activated for the duration of the feature! That means that a random multiplier will land on every remaining spin on all activated positions.

 Landing the Stopwatch symbol awards 2 to 6 additional free spins, indicated by the number shown on the stopwatch display.

scatters.name: THE HIGH-SECURITY VAULT
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus feature with 9 free spins by landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus feature offers an enhanced base game experience, with better odds of landing a greater number of Cash and Multiplier symbols with higher values!

 All landed Cash symbols will have a minimum value of 5x!

 On top of that, all landed Multiplier symbol positions are activated for the duration of the feature! That means that a random multiplier will land on every remaining spin on all activated positions.

 Landing the Stopwatch symbol awards 2 to 6 additional free spins, indicated by the number shown on the stopwatch display.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Multiplier symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

wilds.name: BOOSTBAR™
wilds.behavior:
Introducing our latest feature BOOSTBAR™. An exciting feature bar that consists of four extra positions located above the reels. Every time that a BOOSTBAR™ activator symbol lands on the grid, the BOOSTBAR™ is activated and 4 special feature symbols will land on the bar. The symbols can be either blocking stones, a symbol that clears the grid, paying symbols, symbol multipliers, global multipliers or wilds. If one or more stones land, those positions are locked.

 BOOSTBAR™ FEATURE OVERVIEW:

 BLOCKING STONES

 This symbol blocks the position it lands on until the next round.

 MAGIC LANTERN

 This symbol will jump out of the bar and land on the grid. Once it lands it will clear the grid and a new symbol drop will take place.

 SYMBOLS WITH SPLITTER FUNCTIONALITY

 Can be any of the paying symbols, they will also have an amount in the top right corner. The amount tells you how many symbols will jump out of the bar and land on a random position on the grid.
The amounts can be 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 symbols.

 WILDS

 Wild symbols will jump out of the bar and land on a random position on the grid. They can have an amount in the top right corner - the amount tells you how many symbols will jump out.
The amounts can be 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 or 30.

 SYMBOL MULTIPLIERS

 Can be any of the paying symbols. Each symbol has a multiplier displayed in the top right corner. The multiplier amount will be multiplied by all wins on that symbol during the round. If there are two or more with the same symbol the multiplier values will first be added and then multiplied by the wins.
The symbol multiplier amounts can be 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x or 30x. 

 GLOBAL MULTIPLIERS

 These multipliers are global, which means that all wins during the round will be multiplied by the value. If land several global multipliers and/or symbol multipliers, all applicable multiplier values will first be added and then multiplied by the wins.
The global multiplier amounts can be 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x,

wilds.name: A VERY CRANKY CAT
wilds.behavior:
The Cranky Cat symbol is a wild multiplier that multiplies all the winning combinations that it’s part of in the base game. More than one Cranky Cat can land at the same time and be part of the same winning combination, or different ones. When more than one Cranky Cat is part of the same win, their values multiply each other and the product is then applied to the win.

 Each Cranky Cat can have the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20

 In the base game, at most one Cranky Cat can land at a time on each reel and the Cranky Cat symbol substitutes for all other symbols in the paytable.

scatters.name: BONUS
scatters.behavior:
Land 3 BONUS! scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the Bonus feature!

 In the Bonus, the game transforms and only non-paying symbols and multiplier scatter symbols will appear!

 Above each reel is a reel multiplier that starts at 1x. By landing multiplier symbols of different types, the reel multipliers above the reels are progressively increased! When the Bonus ends, all reel multipliers will be added together and then multiplied with your bet to determine the final win amount!

 The special multiplier symbols that appear in the Bonus feature are as follows.

 Sketchy Skull: adds its displayed value to the reel multiplier where it landed one time.
Sticky Sketchy Skull: stays on the grid and adds its displayed value to the reel multiplier where it landed on every subsequent spin.
Epic Sketchy Skull: adds its displayed value to ALL reel multipliers one time.
Epic Sticky Sketchy Skull: stays on the grid and adds its displayed value to ALL reel multipliers on every subsequent spin.

 Possible multiplier values for all Sketchy Skull symbols are: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x

 Cranky Cat: multiplies its displayed value with the reel multiplier where it landed one time.
Sticky Cranky Cat: stays on the grid and multiplies its displayed value with the reel multiplier where it landed on every subsequent spin.
Epic Cranky Cat: multiplies its displayed value with ALL reel multipliers one time.
Epic Sticky Cranky Cat: stays on the grid and multiplies its displayed value with ALL reel multipliers on every subsequent spin.

 Possible multiplier values for all Cranky Cat symbols are: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20

 The Bonus has 3 refilling lives that reset each time one of the above multiplier symbols lands. Each life represents one spin. Once all 3 lives are consumed without a new reset, the Bonus ends.

scatters.name: SUPER BONUS
scatters.behavior:
Land 4 BONUS! scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the Super Bonus feature!

 The Super Bonus feature follows the rules for the Bonus feature above, with one exception!

 The first spin of each Super Bonus is guaranteed to have a minimum of 7 multiplier symbols from among those listed in the BONUS section.

scatters.name: BEST OF BONUS
scatters.behavior:
When 3 BONUS! scatter symbols land at the same time as a BEST OF BONUS scatter symbol in the base game, the BEST OF BONUS feature is activated!

 This feature awards three Bonus features in a row, playing them out in full before storing the result on the scoreboard next to the grid!

 At the end of the third and final Bonus, the highest value from the scoreboard is awarded and multiplied with your bet to determine the final win amount!

scatters.name: BEST OF SUPER BONUS
scatters.behavior:
When 4 BONUS! scatter symbols land at the same time as a BEST OF BONUS scatter symbol in the base game, the BEST OF SUPER BONUS feature is activated!

 This feature awards three Super Bonus features in a row, playing them out in full before storing the result on the scoreboard next to the grid!

 At the end of the third and final Super Bonus, the highest value from the scoreboard is awarded and multiplied with your bet to determine the final win amount!

multipliers.name: A DROP OF EPIC PROPORTIONS
multipliers.behavior:
The Epic Drop™ feature has a chance to be randomly activated at the start of each spin when playing the base game. When this feature is activated the game will morph into the bonus game and a minimum of five multiplier symbols from the Bonus will drop in to give you their multipliers!

 On the next spin, the game reverts back to the usual base game and continues as usual… unless you were lucky enough to activate another Epic Drop™!

multipliers.name: CAN YOU SPELL CHAOS?
multipliers.behavior:
Landing 5 low-paying symbols that spell out CHAOS horizontally across a row will trigger an EPIC DROP™.

 When the EPIC DROP™ is activated in normal gameplay, it triggers 1 reward spin. During the EPIC DROP™ reward spin, a Reel Multiplier above each reel starts at 1x. All symbols are replaced with dead symbols, and all 5 low-paying CHAOS symbols are transformed into Glitch Dog symbols, which jump to new positions before the grid settles.

 Once the Glitch Dog symbol lands in its new position, each Glitch Dog symbol will glitch into a Crazy Multiplier symbol.

 The 4 Crazy Multiplier symbols are:

 Sketchy Skull symbols add their revealed value to the Reel Multiplier for the reel they land on once.

 Epic Sketchy Skull symbols add their revealed value to all Reel Multipliers once.

 Possible Adding Multiplier values for all Sketchy Skull symbols are: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 Cranky Cat symbols multiply their revealed value with the Reel Multiplier for the reel they land on once.

 Epic Cranky Cat symbols multiply all Reel Multipliers by their revealed value once.

 Possible Multiplying Multiplier values for all Cranky Cat symbols are: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20.

 The Reel Multipliers above the reels increase progressively depending on which Crazy Multiplier is revealed by the Glitch Dog symbol or from other Crazy Multiplier symbols that can land. Crazy Multipliers and Glitch Dog symbols reveal in order from top to bottom, left to right. When the reward spin ends, all Reel Multipliers are added together and multiplied by your bet amount to determine the final awarded win. The grid then resets, and the Reel Multiplier is removed for the next spin.

modes.name: BONUS GAME - CTRL + ALT + CHAOS
modes.trigger: landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with free spins and 3 refilling lives by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 In this bonus game, lives are displayed on a Life Meter outside the grid, where 3 lives equal 3 free spins. When any Crazy Multiplier symbol lands, the lives and free spins are refilled to 3. A Glitch Dog symbol will refill the Life Meter to max, only the first time it lands on the grid. Once all lives are consumed, the bonus ends.

 Additionally, the Reel Multiplier, which starts at 1x, remains active outside the grid throughout the bonus. Only dead symbols, Glitch Dog symbols, and Crazy Multipliers can land. By landing different Crazy Multipliers or Glitch Dog symbols, the Reel Multipliers above the reels progressively increase during the bonus.

 When a Glitch Dog symbol lands, it glitches into one of the Crazy Multiplier symbols at the time of the symbols' reveal. That Crazy Multiplier value will be added to the Reel Multiplier. After all the reveals and all the Multipliers have been added to the Reel Multiplier, the Glitch Dog symbol returns to its original form and jumps to a new position on the next spin. When it lands, it glitches into a new Crazy Multiplier when it’s time for its reveal. This continues until the end of the bonus.

 At the end of the bonus, all Reel Multipliers are added together and multiplied by your bet amount to determine the final awarded win.

modes.name: BONUS GAME - THE KORRUPTED K9
modes.trigger: landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.effects:

 Crazy Multipliers and Glitch Dog symbols within the 3x3 square will first reveal their values. Then, the Chaos Upgrade symbol adds its Multiplier value to each Crazy Multiplier and Glitch Dog symbol in the square. Finally, the updated Multiplier values are added to the Reel Multiplier. The Multiplier value of the Chaos Upgrade symbol itself is not added to the Reel Multiplier.

 The Chaos Upgrade symbol is removed from the grid for the next free spin. Landing Chaos Upgrade symbols does not refill the Life Meter. Only 1 Chaos Upgrade symbol can land on the grid at a time.

modes.name: FREE SPINS
modes.trigger: land three Free Spin symbols, the game changes into free spin mode.
modes.effects:
If you land three Free Spin symbols, the game changes into free spin mode. The free spins mode starts with 3 spins. The free spins continue until you get three non-winning spins in a row. Every time you get a winning symbol, the number of free spins is reset to 3. The meter to the right of the grid displays the number of remaining spins.

The symbols appearing in the free spins mode are described below:

 Every time the Cranky Cat symbol appears, it will multiply the number shown above the current reel with the factor revealed inside the Cranky Cat symbol. The possible multipliers are x2, x3, x5, x10, x20.

 Cranky Cat also has an Epic version. This symbol works the same way as the regular Cranky Cat symbol, but multiplies the value displayed above all reels with the factor shown! The possible multipliers are x2, x3, x5, x10, x20.

 The Sketchy Skull symbol will add the number revealed inside the Sketchy Skull symbol to the current reel’s multiplier. The possible multipliers are +1, +2, +5, +10, +20.

 The Epic Sketchy Skull symbol will add the number revealed inside the Sketchy Skull symbol to the factors shown above all reels! The possible multipliers are +1, +2, +5, +10, +20.

 These symbols are non-winning.

respins.how_it_works:
When a Tree of Life has fully expanded from the bottom row to the top row of a reel, the Circle of Life is triggered on that Tree of Life. The Circle of Life will activate during the Respin before the grid has settled.

 The Circle of Life spins and lands on a Multiplier or a Skull. The Multiplier on which the arrow lands will be combined with the Multiplier on the Tree of Life. If the arrow lands on an Additive Multiplier, the two values will be added together for a new total Multiplier on the Tree of Life. If the arrow lands on a Multiplicative Multiplier, the Tree of Life value will be multiplied by the Circle of Life value for a new total. The Circle of Life Multipliers can have the following values:

 Additive Multiplying values: 2x, 3x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 100x

 Multiplicative Multiplying value: x2

 The Circle of Life will continue spinning and landing on Multiplier values until the arrow lands on the Skull, which ends the Circle of Life. The grid will settle, and new wins formed with the Tree of Life are awarded with the new total Multiplier value on the Tree of Life. A new Respin is triggered, and the Tree of Life is removed from the grid.

wilds.name: TREE OF LIFE
wilds.behavior:
When a Tree symbol lands, it acts as a Wild symbol that substitutes for all symbols in the paytable and reveals a Multiplier value. If the Tree symbol is part of a win, it triggers a Respin, and the Tree symbol expands into a Tree of Life.

 When a Tree symbol forms part of a winning combination, the win is multiplied by the value shown on the Tree symbol. If more than one Tree symbol is part of the same winning combination, their values are first added together before being applied to the win. Tree symbols have the following Additive Multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 Once the wins are awarded, a Respin is triggered, the winning Tree symbols will stick to the grid and expand upward by one row into a Tree of Life while everything else respins. The Respin sequence continues when new wins occur on the Tree of Life or other Tree symbols on the grid. The Tree of Life will continue to expand by one row on every Respin sequence until the Tree of Life fully expands by reaching the top of the grid. Once fully expanded, the Tree of Life will be removed from the grid on the next Respin or next spin.

scatters.name: SPREADING FS SYMBOLS
scatters.behavior:
When 3 or more FS scatter symbols land simultaneously, each FS symbol expands across the entire reel it lands on after all wins have been awarded. Every position the FS symbol covers represents a certain number of free spins. The total number of free spins awarded for the bonus is determined by adding up all the numbers on positions covered by each FS symbol. FS symbols can have the following values: +1, +2, +3.

 When triggering and buying a bonus, there is a chance that some positions on expanding FS symbols will transform into Upgrade symbols, upgrading you to the next bonus.

 Landing 3 expanding FS symbols with 1 Upgrade symbol awards an upgrade to the ETERNAL bonus.

 Landing 3 expanding FS symbols with 2 Upgrade symbols awards an upgrade to the REBIRTH bonus.

 Landing 4 expanding FS symbols with 1 Upgrade symbol awards an upgrade to the REBIRTH bonus.

scatters.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - REBIRTH
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with free spins by landing 5 expanding FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game keeps the mechanics of the ETERNAL bonus. In addition, reels 2 and 4 are activated from the start!

 Expanding FS symbols cannot land in this bonus.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 A Tree symbol and a FS symbol cannot land on the same reel at the same time.

 Only 3 expanding FS symbols can land per spin in the ORIGIN and the ETERNAL bonus.

multipliers.name: Cursed Chests
multipliers.behavior:
Landed Cursed Chests open up to create a Cursed Area from their position to the top of the reel, if the Cursed Area would include at least one winning combination.

 Opened Cursed Chests reveal a Cursed Multiplier that is applied to the Cursed Area on that reel.  All Cursed Multipliers from opened Cursed Chests are added to a Total Multiplier above the reels, which affects all Cursed Areas. All winning paylines that pass through any Cursed Areas are multiplied by the Total Multiplier.

wilds.behavior:
If 4 or more Diamond symbols land in a square formation of 2x2, 3x3, 4x4 or 5x5 they merge to form a Colossal Diamond symbol. multipliers.name: BOLT SYMBOLS
multipliers.behavior:
A Bolt symbol is activated when it lands within a 3x3 square formation surrounding a Diamond symbol or Colossal Diamond symbol. When activated, the Bolt symbol applies a Multiplier value or increases the Multiplier values of all Diamond symbols and Colossal Diamonds inside the surrounding 3x3 square formation before any wins are rewarded. When the wins have been awarded, the Bolt symbol spins out from the grid along the regular paying symbols. Bolt symbols can land during regular spins and Dandy Respins. Bolt symbols add one of the following Additive Multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x.

 An Epic Bolt symbol will activate when it lands while there is any Diamond on the grid. An activated Epic Bolt symbol applies a Multiplier value or increases the Multiplier values of all Diamond symbols and Colossal Diamond symbols on the grid before any wins have been handled. When the wins have been handled, the Epic Bolt symbol spins out from the grid along the regular paying symbols. Epic Bolt symbols can land during regular spins and Dandy Respins. The Epic Bolt symbol adds one of the following Additive Multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x.

 Only 1 Bolt and Epic Bolt can land during the same spin. When a Bolt and Epic Bolt symbol land and activate during the same spin, the Bolt symbol will activate before the Epic Bolt symbol.

 When the Diamond symbol has landed, it will trigger a Dandy Respin after all winning combinations have been handled. cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
When Summoning symbols land, their size can be 1x2, 1x3 or 1x4. When Summoning symbols land, they all reveal a different stack of the same paying or Wild symbol. The symbol size determines the number of stacked symbols on each Summoning symbol.

 Summoning symbol size 1x2 reveals 3, 4, 5 or 6 symbol stacks.

 Summoning symbol size 1x3 reveals 5, 6, 7, 8 or 9 symbol stacks.

 Summoning symbol size 1x4 reveals 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 or 12 symbol stacks.

 If a Wild symbol lands directly above or directly below a Summoning symbol on the same reel, the Summoning symbol will increase in size by expanding to cover that Wild symbol once the grid is settled.

 When Summoning symbols are part of a win, they will stay on the grid as other winning symbols cascade out. The winning Summoning symbols will reveal a new paying or Wild symbol. If subsequent wins occur, the Summoning symbols will reveal a new paying or Wild symbol; this continues until no new wins occur. 

 When there are no more wins, all symbols, including the Summoning symbols, are removed from the grid for the next spin. Summoning symbols can land on reels 2, 3, 4 and 5.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
When a winning combination occurs all symbols of the winning type are marked and removed from the grid after all current wins have been awarded.

 New symbols cascade in to replace the removed symbols, potentially creating new wins and additional cascades.

wilds.name: WILD MULTIPLIERS
wilds.behavior:
The Wild symbols substitute for all other symbols in the paytable. There are two Wild symbol variants, a blue Wild and a red Wild. The blue Wild appears in the base game and in the Rise to Salvation bonus feature. The red Wild appears in the Trial by Hellfire bonus feature. There is no functional difference between the two variants.

 When a Wild symbol appears it may have one of the following multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x. Wild symbols cannot appear with a multiplier in the Rise to Salvation bonus feature.

 If more than one multiplier is part of the same winning combination, their values are added together before being applied to the win.

wilds.name: WILL OF THE ORDER
wilds.behavior:
When an Order scatter symbol lands it will replace itself and 1 - 9 other symbols with Wild symbols, which may appear with or without multipliers.

 If more than one Order symbol lands at the same time, Will of the Order will be triggered once for each Order symbol.

scatters.name: UNHOLY SUMMONING
scatters.behavior: Any Unholy scatter symbols that land together with at least one winning combination are collected at the top-right corner of the grid and saved for the duration of the round. If 3 Unholy symbols land at the same time, they are immediately collected regardless of any winning combinations.

specials.name: SUPER CASCADE
specials.behavior:
When a winning combination occurs all symbols of the winning type are marked and removed from the grid after all current wins have been awarded.

 New symbols cascade in to replace the removed symbols, potentially creating new wins and additional cascades.

modes.name: TRIAL BY HELLFIRE BONUS FEATURE
modes.effects:
Collect 3 Unholy symbols during the same round in the base game to activate this bonus feature with 10 free spins.

 During the bonus, all winning positions are marked with Hellfire. 

 When an Unholy symbol lands it will activate the Fires of Hell sequence. At the start of this sequence, the Unholy symbol and all symbols on positions marked by Hellfire are replaced with Wild symbols, which may appear with or without multipliers. All Hellfire is then removed.

 The Fires of Hell sequence last until the next cascade. While the Fires of Hell sequence is active, new wins do not create Hellfire.

modes.name: RISE TO SALVATION BONUS FEATURE
modes.effects:
If you collect 3 Unholy symbols during the same round in the base game and an Order symbol is present when the third Unholy symbol is collected, this bonus feature is activated with 10 free spins.

 During the bonus, the symbol drop and cascade direction is reversed so that symbols move upwards instead of downwards.

 This bonus has special Lost Soul symbols. Whenever a Lost Soul lands, it becomes persistent and stays on the reels until the end of the bonus, or until it Ascends.

 Lost Souls move upward together with other cascading symbols to fill the empty spaces left behind by removed wins. When a Lost Soul reaches the top row of the grid, it Ascends and is removed.

 There are two Lost Soul symbol variants, a Global Multiplier Lost Soul and a Cash Prize Lost Soul.

 When the Global Multiplier Lost soul reaches the top row and Ascends, it adds one of the following multiplier values to a global multiplier above the reels: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 25x, 50x, 100x. The global multiplier is applied to all winning combinations.

 When the Cash Prize Lost Soul reaches the top row and Ascends, it awards one of the following cash prizes: 10, 15, 20, 25, 50, 100 or 666 times the bet. Cash prizes are also multiplied by the value of the global multiplier.

 If three non-winning spins occur in a row, 3 - 5 random Low- or High-paying symbols are removed from the grid on the third spin.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Order symbol does not appear in the Trial by Hellfire bonus feature.

 The Unholy symbol does not appear in the Rise to Salvation bonus feature. The Unholy symbol does not appear on reel 1 or 2.

wilds.name: JOKER SYMBOL
wilds.behavior:
The JOKER symbol acts as a Wild in Classic Mode, substituting for all paying symbols in the paytable. Only one JOKER symbol can land at the same time in Classic Mode.

 After it lands and all payline wins have been awarded, the grid flips to Poker Mode and the JOKER symbol transforms into one of four Joker card options:

 Regular Joker 
 Hand Multiplier Joker 
 Global Multiplier Joker 
 Triple Trouble Joker 

 The different Joker card features are explained below.

scatters.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - FOOL’S GOLD
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during Classic Mode in the base game. If a JOKER symbol lands on the same spin, the bonus game will be activated after any Poker Mode wins are awarded.

 This bonus keeps the mechanics of the DEALBREAKER bonus. In addition, a JOKER symbol is guaranteed to land on every spin, triggering Poker Mode!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in Classic Mode in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins,

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 FS symbols that land in Classic Mode will transform into a random Joker card if the game enters Poker Mode on the same spin.

multipliers.name: HAND MULTIPLIER JOKER
multipliers.behavior:
This Joker activates before Poker Hand wins are calculated, and awards a Poker Hand Multiplier that is applied on the row where it landed, for one spin. The Poker Hand Multiplier can be one of the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, or 10x.

 After the multiplier has been awarded, the Joker transforms into a regular poker card, always picking the best option for the row where it landed.

 If more than one Hand Multiplier Joker lands on the same row, their multipliers will be added together.

multipliers.name: GLOBAL MULTIPLIER JOKER
multipliers.behavior:
This Joker activates before Poker Hand wins are calculated, and awards a Global Multiplier that is applied to all winning Poker Hands on the grid, for one spin. The Global Multiplier can be one of the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, or 10x.

 After the multiplier has been awarded, the Joker transforms into a regular poker card, always picking the best option for the row where it landed.

 If a Global Multiplier affects a winning Poker Hand that is also affected by another multiplier, the values will be added together.

collectors.name: TRIPLE TROUBLE JOKER
collectors.behavior:
This Joker has a delayed activation that triggers after Poker Hand wins are calculated.

 Before calculating Poker Hand wins, the Joker transforms into a regular poker card, always picking the best option for the row where it landed.

 Once all Poker Hand wins on the current grid have been awarded, all cards on the grid are collected, shuffled and then the three best possible Poker Hands from all the collected cards are dealt back onto the grid and awarded one by one, in ascending order.

 Non-winning Joker cards on the grid will transform into a random poker card.

specials.behavior: Classic Mode is the base mode of the game, and acts as a typical game with reels, paying symbols, and payline wins.

specials.name: POKER MODE
specials.behavior:
Poker Mode is activated by landing the JOKER symbol.

 In Poker Mode, all the paying symbols on the grid are transformed into poker cards. Each row represents one Poker Hand, and each row will automatically create the best possible winning combination from the 5 cards on that row (based on the Poker Hand Paytable below).

 All cards drawn in Poker Mode are randomly generated and do not correspond to a physical deck of cards.

specials.name: STRAIGHT FLUSH

specials.name: FOUR OF A KIND

specials.name: FULL HOUSE
specials.behavior: FULL HOUSE is worth 75 times your bet. This Poker Hand consists of three cards of one rank and two of another rank.

specials.name: FLUSH
specials.behavior: FLUSH is worth 50 times your bet. This Poker Hand consists of five cards of the same suit.

specials.name: STRAIGHT
specials.behavior: STRAIGHT is worth 25 times your bet. This Poker Hand consists of five consecutive cards of any suit.

specials.name: THREE OF A KIND
specials.behavior: THREE OF A KIND is worth 10 times your bet. This Poker Hand consists of three cards of the same rank.

specials.name: TWO PAIR
specials.behavior: TWO PAIR is worth 5 times your bet. This Poker Hand consists of two pair of cards of two different ranks.

expanding_reels.how_it_works:
When a Densho symbol lands, it expands into a Multiplier Reel if the expanded reel would be part of at least one winning combination once expanded.

 Multiplier Reels are wild and substitute for all other paying symbols, and apply a multiplier to each winning combination they are part of. If a winning combination includes more than one Multiplier Reel, their multipliers are added together before being applied to the win. The multiplier value on each Multiplier Reel is determined by the quality of the Densho symbol that created it:

 The possible multiplier values from the Common Densho symbol are: 2x - 10x

 The possible multiplier values from the Rare Densho symbol are: 5x - 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x

 The possible multiplier values from the Legendary Densho symbol are: 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x

 Each reel can land only one Densho symbol at once.

respins.how_it_works:
Land 3 or 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game to trigger one of the bonus games.

 You can also trigger one of the bonuses by collecting FS symbols during respins. If only 1 or 2 FS symbols land on a spin they are collected in the Bonus Meter above the reels if there is at least one Wild Multiplier with 1 or more Vitality. Once the Bonus Meter reaches 3 or 4 collected FS symbols, it will trigger the corresponding bonus game at the end of the round (after any potential respins have been awarded).

wilds.name: WILD MULTIPLIER
wilds.behavior:
The Wild Multiplier symbol substitutes for all other symbols in the paytable and multiplies the value of any winning combination that it is part of. Wild Multipliers can land with one of the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x.

 If more than one Wild Multiplier is part of the same winning combination, their values are added together before being applied to the win.

 Wild Multipliers may land with up to 3 Vitality, shown on the symbol as red hearts. While a Wild Multiplier has Vitality remaining, it stays sticky on the grid and awards respins. For each respin awarded, 1 Vitality is removed from every Wild Multiplier on the grid. When a Wild Multiplier reaches 0 Vitality, it will be removed on the next spin or respin.

multipliers.name: DOLLAR-REELS
multipliers.behavior:
When a Danny symbol lands, it will expand into a Dollar-Reel if the Danny symbol is part of a LootLine win, or the expanded Dollar-Reel is part of a LootLine win.

 Danny symbols only expand upward, to the top of the grid, after all regular wins are collected. Once expanded, the Dollar-Reel and every position it covers can be part of a LootLine. Dollar-Reels will reveal a Multiplier value on every position that the Dollar-Reel covers, positions can have different Multiplier values. Dollar-Reel Multipliers can have the following Multiplying values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, x10.

 When there is a winning LootLine of Donny symbols and a Dollar-Reel on the grid, the payout of the LootLine will be determined by the values of the symbols that are a part of the win. The values will be applied from left to right, the resulting value is then multiplied by your bet to determine the cash prize. Dollar-Reel Multiplying Multipliers that come first on a winning payline will be treated as Additive Multipliers.

 For example, a winning LootLine that consists of 1 Dollar-Reel symbol, 1 Donny symbol and 1 Dollar-Reel symbol with the values x3, 15x and x2 will have a final payout of 3+15*2=36x.

 Only 1 Danny symbol can land on a reel at a time. A Dollar-Reel cannot expand over a Donny symbol.

The values are added from left to right, top to bottom, and multiplied by the current bet amount to determine the awarded win. The Cash Board values are based on the following bet Multipliers: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x, 150x, 250x, 500x, 1000x, 5000x, 12 500x.

 When there is a winning payline of Multi-Dough symbols on the grid, a light bulb is lit above all the reels that were a part of the win. One light bulb is lit on each reel for each Multi-Dough symbol on that reel that was a part of a win. A maximum of four light bulbs can be lit at the same time.

 When a Donny’s Hat symbol lands on the grid, it will trigger a re-spin if any light bulbs above the reels are lit. multipliers.name: LOOTLINES
multipliers.behavior:
When you see the Multi-Dough symbol with Donny’s happy face on the grid, it means that there is a chance for big rewards. There are four versions of the Multi-Dough symbols that can land with one of the following values:

 Adding Multi-Dough symbol: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x

 Revealing adding Multi-Dough symbol: 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x

 Multiplying Multi-Dough symbol: x2, x3, x4, x5

 Revealing multiplying Multi-Dough symbol: x6, x7, x8, x9, x10, x15, x20, x25

 Revealing Multi-Dough symbols land with a question mark on the symbol, and then reveal their value.

 When there is a winning payline of Multi-Dough symbols on the grid, the payout of the payline will be determined by the values of the Multi-Dough symbols that are a part of the win. The values will be applied from left to right. Multiplying multipliers that appears on the left-most reel will be treated as Adding multipliers. For example, a winning payline that consists of four Multi-Dough symbols with the values x3, 4x, 1x and x2 will have a final payout of (3+4+1)*2=16x. The resulting value is then multiplied with your bet to form the win.

wilds.name: GOOEY GUNS AND GOOEY WILDS
wilds.behavior:
When a Gooey Gun symbol lands it shoots Gooey Wild symbols to the left on the same row, as far as the edge of the grid. The Gooey Gun symbol then transforms into a Gooey Wild! Gooey Gun symbols can also land with a multiplier value from one of the following values: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 Gooey Wild symbols are wild symbols that substitute for all other symbols in the paytable. All Gooey Wild symbols fired or transformed from a Gooey Gun take on the same multiplier value as the Gun, and the multiplier values are added together into one value which is applied to all connected Gooey Wilds on the same row.

 When at least one Gooey Wild with a multiplier is part of a winning payline, that multiplier is applied to the win. If a winning payline includes Gooey Wild multipliers from more than one row of connected Gooey Wild symbols, their multiplier values are added together before being applied to the win.

 The multiplier value from a row of connected Gooey Wild symbols cannot be applied more than once per winning combination, regardless of how many winning symbols are on that row.

scatters.behavior:
Landing 3 or 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game brings you into the Bonus Choice menu, where you are able to choose between two bonus game options depending on the number of landed FS symbols.

 With 3 FS symbols, you may choose either the WAREHOUSE or the STAKEOUT bonus games.

 With 4 FS symbols, you may choose either the SUPER WAREHOUSE or the SUPER STAKEOUT bonus games.

 2 FS symbols awards 2 additional spins,

 3 FS symbols awards 4 additional spins.

scatters.name: SUPER STAKEOUT

 Landing additional FS scatter symbols during the feature awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols awards 2 additional spins,

 3 FS symbols awards 4 additional spins.

multipliers.name: WAREHOUSE
multipliers.behavior:

 Each spin in the bonus consumes 1 life and has 2 Flashlight Charges. Whenever a special symbol is revealed, your lives are refilled to 3. After 3 consecutive spins without a refill, the bonus will end.

 This bonus features two flashlights that reveal the hidden darkened symbols on the grid. On every new spin, the flashlights will shine on random positions on the grid and reveal the symbol on that position.

 If a special symbol is revealed, it will produce a certain effect depending on the revealed symbol, and the flashlight will move to a new position without consuming a Flashlight Charge or a life. The special symbol effects are detailed below.

 When an Adding or Multiplying Multiplier symbol is revealed, the value of that multiplier will be collected in the Total Multiplier above the grid.

 Multiplier symbols can have the following values:

 Adding Multipliers: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x

 Multiplying Multipliers: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10

wilds.name: GIFT BOXES
wilds.behavior:
Gift Boxes are wild multipliers. There are three different kinds of Gift Boxes: Common Gift Box, Rare Gift Box and Epic Gift Box. The Common Gift Boxes always show their multiplier value. The Rare and Epic Gift Boxes only reveal their multiplier value when they are part of a winning combination. All winning combinations that a Gift Box is part of will be multiplied with the shown value. If more than one Gift Box is part of the same winline, their multipliers are first added together and then applied to the win.

 The Common Gift Box can have the values: Wild, 2x, 3x, 4x

 The Rare Gift Box can have the values: 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x

 The Epic Gift Box can have the values: 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x, 150x, 200x

 If you land 3 Gift Boxes of any kind on the same spin the Gift Bonanza bonus game is awarded!. The placement and the value of the triggering Gift Boxes is carried over into the bonus.

wilds.name: DORK SPINS
wilds.behavior:
Landing 3 Lenny symbols activates the Dork Spins bonus game.

 In Dork Spins, the Lenny symbol can land only on reels 2, 3 and 4. When the Lenny symbol lands, it expands into a wild Dork Reel! Expanded Dork Reels remain expanded until the bonus ends!

 On every spin one of the Dorks will appear on each expanded Dork Reel and reveal a multiplier value based on which Dork appeared. All connecting winlines are multiplied by the shown value. If a winline connects to more than one Dork Reel, the multipliers are added together before being applied to the win.

 Tiny Timmy can reveal these multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x

 Hefty Hector can reveal these multiplier values: 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x

 Long Lenny can reveal these multiplier values: 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x, 150x, 200x

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 Gift Box symbols substitute for all paying symbols in the paytable. Gift Box symbols do not appear in the Dork Spins bonus feature. 

The Lenny symbol can land in any position in the base game. The Lenny symbol does not appear in the Gift Bonanza bonus feature.

specials.name: GIFT BONANZA
specials.behavior: All landed Gift Boxes are sticky throughout the whole bonus game. The bonus starts with 3 spins. Landing additional Gift Boxes refills the remaining spins to 3 and keeps the bonus going! 3 spins in a row without landing any new Gift Boxes ends the bonus.

wilds.name: EXPANDING WILD REELS
wilds.behavior:
When a Treasure Chest symbol lands it will expand into a Wild Reel if it would be part of a winning combination once expanded.

 Expanded Wild Reels cover the entire reel and will show one of the following characters: Octopus, Mermaid or Ocean King! Each character has a different multiplier tier with increasing multiplier values!

 The Octopus can have one of the following multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x

 The Mermaid can have one of the following multiplier values: 10x, 15x, 20x

 The Ocean King can have one of the following multiplier values: 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x

 The landed character’s multiplier is applied across the entire Wild Reel and affects any winning combinations that it is part of.

 All Wild Reel positions count as Wild symbols and substitute for all other symbols in the paytable.

 If more than one Wild Reels are part of the same winning combination, their multipliers are added together before being applied to the win.

 Treasure Chest symbols can land on any reel, but only 1 Treasure Chest symbol can land on a reel at a time.

modes.name: DEEP BLUE BONUS GAME
modes.trigger: Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the DEEP BLUE bonus game with 10 free spins.
modes.effects:
Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the DEEP BLUE bonus game with 10 free spins.

 This bonus maintains the mechanics of the base game with the addition that a landed Treasure Chest symbol always expands and becomes a Wild Reel regardless of whether it is part of a win or not.

 Furthermore, expanded Wild Reels will reveal 0 - 3 lives and are sticky into the next spin as long as they have lives remaining. 1 life is removed from each sticky Wild Reel at the beginning of each spin. At the start of each spin, sticky Wild Reels will receive a new random multiplier from any of the three character tiers.

 If there is at least one Wild Reel with 1 or more lives remaining on the last free spin of the bonus game, the Last Chance feature will activate! Last Chance will award free respins and keep the bonus game active until no Wild Reels have any lives left.

 During Last Chance, additional Treasure Chest symbols can land on the grid and turn into new expanded Wild Reels with or without lives. If the Wild Reel reveals lives, the number of lives will never exceed the number of lives of any existing Wild Reels.

 The bonus game ends when there are no spins and no Wild Reels with lives remaining.

 Landing additional FS symbols during the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award 2 additional spins,

 3 FS symbols award 4 additional spins.

wilds.name: WILD EYEBALL SYMBOLS
wilds.behavior:
When an EyeBall symbol lands, it can only land on the 4th row of the grid. Once the grid has settled, all EyeBall symbols shoot in 1 of 3 directions: straight up, diagonally left, or diagonally right. EyeBall symbols activate in order from left to right.

 When an EyeBall shoots, every paying symbol along its path transforms into a Wild symbol. These transformed symbols can remain Wild or reveal an Additive Multiplier value. Wild symbols substitute for all symbols in the paytable. Multiplier values revealed on Wild symbols can be: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x.

 If an EyeBall symbol hits an existing Wild symbol, that Wild symbol gains a Multiplier value. If an EyeBall symbol hits a Wild symbol with a Multiplier, the Multiplier value of that Wild will increase by adding a new Multiplier value to the existing Wild Multiplier. Multiplier values added to Wild symbols can be: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x.

 Activated EyeBall symbols transform into Wild symbols. If more than 1 Wild Multiplier symbol is part of the same winning combination, the values are first added together before being applied to the win.

wilds.name: ENERGY FIELDS
wilds.behavior:
There are 3 Energy Fields located on the left, top, and right edges of the grid. If an EyeBall symbol activates and hits an Energy Field, the EyeBall will bounce off the Energy Field and continue in another direction at the same angle. The EyeBall symbol will continue to transform paying symbols in its path into Wild symbols.

 When an EyeBall symbol hits a Energy Field straight on, the EyeBall will bounce back the same way it came from, adding Multiplier values to the transformed Wild symbols. If an EyeBall hits an EyeBall symbol, it adds a Multiplier value.

 FS symbols cannot land at the same time as EyeBall symbols.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
Charred Land symbols are Wild multipliers that have 3 charges when they land.

 After a Charred Land symbol is part of one or more wins it loses a charge before the next cascade. Each time that a symbol cascade occurs, every Charred Land currently on the grid has its multiplier value increased by 1.

 If more than one Charred Land is part of a win, their values are added together before being applied to the win.

 Charred Land multipliers can land with one of the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x.

multipliers.name: DRAGON SYMBOLS AND DRAGONFIRE
multipliers.behavior:
Dragon symbols on the grid will activate once the grid is fully settled and no more wins occur, breathing Dragonfire in a cross-pattern from its position. All regular paying symbols hit by the Dragonfire will be removed from the grid. If Dragonfire hits any Charred Land symbols, the charges on those Charred Land symbols will be refilled.

 Dragon symbols come in two different colors: Red and Gold.

 Gold Dragon symbols will have a multiplier from one of the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10.

 Whenever a Charred Land symbol is hit by Dragonfire from a Gold Dragon, its multiplier is multiplied by the value on the Gold Dragon.

 Whenever a Dragon Egg symbol is hit by Dragonfire from a Gold Dragon, the egg’s value is multiplied by the value on the Gold Dragon.

wilds.name: DROP SYMBOL
wilds.behavior:
When one or more Drop symbols land, the Drop mechanic will activate after any winning combinations on the initial grid have been awarded.

 Each Drop symbol will fall downward and out of the grid and remove all symbols below it. Any symbols above the Drop symbol will fall to the bottom of the reel.

 The empty spaces on each reel will then be filled with the same randomly chosen symbol. In the base game, this symbol will be chosen from any of the paying symbols or the Wild symbol.

 If the new symbols create a winning combination, that win will be awarded. If a winning combination created by the new symbols could also include symbols which have already been a part of a winning combination before the Drop mechanic activated, those symbols will also be included in the new winning combination.

wilds.name: DROP SPINS BONUS
wilds.behavior:
Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to trigger this feature with 10 free spins.

 This bonus starts with all paying symbols and the Wild symbol in the pool of possible symbols that can be chosen by the Drop mechanic.

 Land the FS symbol in the feature to reveal extra free spins and possibly get an UPGRADE that removes some symbols from the Drop mechanic pool. Each landed FS symbol can award +1, +2 or +3 extra free spins. When revealing an UPGRADE, between 1 to 10 (at most all remaining) paying symbols will be removed from the choice pool. The Wild symbol can never be removed from the pool.

wilds.name: HIGH DROP SPINS BONUS
wilds.behavior:
Land 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to trigger this feature with 10 free spins.

 This bonus starts with only high-paying symbols and the Wild symbol in the pool of possible symbols that can be chosen by the Drop mechanic. 

 Land the FS symbol in the feature to reveal extra free spins and possibly get an UPGRADE that removes some symbols from the Drop mechanic pool. Each landed FS symbol can award +1, +2 or +3 extra free spins. When revealing an UPGRADE, between 1 to 5 (at most all remaining) paying symbols will be removed from the choice pool. The Wild symbol can never be removed from the pool.

wilds.name: BLESSING BAR
wilds.behavior:
A Blessing Bar is located outside the grid which awards Wild symbols and Multipliers on those Wild symbols when full. When a winning combination lands on the grid, the Blessing Bar will start to fill. An 8-symbol win is needed to fill the Blessing Bar the first time. Then the amount of winning symbols needed will increase by +2 symbols each time you fill the Bar. The Blessing Bar will reset between spins if only partially filled.

 When the Blessing Bar is full, it activates and then resets. When activated, the Blessing Bar awards Wild symbols with a Multiplier value each. On the first activation, the Blessing Bar will start with an award of 3 Wild symbols.

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable. When a Wild symbol is part of a win, the Multiplier value is added to all wins connected to that Wild symbol. If more than one Wild symbol with a Multiplier is part of the same winning combination, the values are added together before being applied to the win.

 When the Blessing Bar activates again the number of Wild symbols or the value of the Multiplier that can be awarded will increase upon each subsequent activation. The Wild symbols can increase by 1 each time and the Multiplier value can increase by adding a random Multiplier value to the existing Multiplier on the Blessing Bar. The Additive Multiplier values added to the Blessing Bar can be 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x.

wilds.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - THE NIGHT COURT
wilds.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the base game’s mechanics. In addition, the Blessing Bar will stay full throughout the bonus and activate once on every free spin after regular wins have been handled. The awarded Wild symbol will start at 6 and the Multiplier will start at 10x. The awarded Wild or Multiplier value will increase after the Blessing Bar activates on every spin.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 FS symbols cannot land in THE DUSK COURT, THE LUNAR COURT and THE NIGHT COURT bonus.

wilds.name: DUELREELS™
wilds.behavior:
When a VS or Bounty VS symbol lands, it expands into a DuelReel if part of a winning combination once expanded. Fully expanded DuelReels™ count as Wild reels and substitute for all symbols in the paytable. Once expanded, the DuelReel will cover the entire reel, triggering a Duel between two duelists. Each DuelReel will have 1 Adding Multiplier assigned to each of the 2 duelists.

 When a VS symbol expands, it expands into an Outlaw DuelReel. The Multiplier from the surviving duelists will be applied across that entire DuelReel and is added to all wins connected to that reel. If more than 1 Outlaw DuelReel is part of the same winning combination, their winning Multipliers are added together before being applied to the win.

 The possible Multiplier values for Outlaw DuelReels™ are: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 When a Bounty VS symbol expands, it expands into a Bounty DuelReel with a Duel between the Bounty Hunter and an Outlaw. If the Bounty Hunter wins a Duel, she collects the Multiplier from the Outlaw and combines it with her existing Multiplier, and another Duel is triggered on the same Bounty DuelReel. On the new Duel, the Bounty Hunter will display her combined Multiplier from the previous Duel. This repeats until the Bounty Hunter loses a Duel or after 3 Duels have been played. When the Bounty Hunter loses a Duel, her collected Multiplier is applied to that Bounty DuelReel. The Multiplier values for Bounty DuelReels™ start at 2x.

 Only 1 VS symbol or 1 Bounty VS symbol can land on a reel at a time.

Each DuelReel will have 1 Adding Multiplier assigned to each of the 2 duelists.

 When a VS symbol expands, it expands into an Outlaw DuelReel. The Multiplier from the surviving duelists will be applied across that entire DuelReel and is added to all wins connected to that reel. If more than 1 Outlaw DuelReel is part of the same winning combination, their winning Multipliers are added together before being applied to the win.

 The possible Multiplier values for Outlaw DuelReels™ are: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 When a Bounty VS symbol expands, it expands into a Bounty DuelReel with a Duel between the Bounty Hunter and an Outlaw. If the Bounty Hunter wins a Duel, she collects the Multiplier from the Outlaw and combines it with her existing Multiplier, and another Duel is triggered on the same Bounty DuelReel. On the new Duel, the Bounty Hunter will display her combined Multiplier from the previous Duel. This repeats until the Bounty Hunter loses a Duel or after 3 Duels have been played. When the Bounty Hunter loses a Duel, her collected Multiplier is applied to that Bounty DuelReel. The Multiplier values for Bounty DuelReels™ start at 2x.

 Only 1 VS symbol or 1 Bounty VS symbol can land on a reel at a time.

multipliers.name: WIN TO WIN
multipliers.behavior:
After a winning combination occurs, the squares behind the winning symbols will be highlighted as Divine Squares.

 If there is a Hand of Zeus symbol on the grid it will activate any Divine Squares after all wins have been completed. Activated Divine Squares reveal either Bronze, Silver or Gold Coins, and have a chance to show Vessel of Wealth or Zap of Zeus symbols.

 All Coins are cash prizes that are paid as a multiple of your bet.

 Bronze Coins can have the following values: 0,2x, 0,5x, 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x 
 Silver Coins can have the following values: 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x 
 Gold Coins can have the following values: 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x 

 After all symbols have been revealed, any Zap of Zeus symbols will activate and multiply all Coins or existing Vessel of Wealth symbols on adjacent squares with one of the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10.

 Vessel of Wealth symbols will activate after all Coins have been revealed and all Zap of Zeus symbols have been activated. Vessel of Wealth symbols collect the values of all Coins and other Vessel of Wealth symbols and store their total value. Vessel of Wealth symbols activate top-to-bottom, left-to-right.

 After the last Vessel of Wealth on the current grid has activated, all other Divine Squares will activate again to reveal new symbols and the process above repeats.

 Once all reveals and activations have been completed all Coins and Vessel of Wealth symbols will be added together and multiplied with your bet amount to determine the final awarded win.
