modes.name: BERSERK FREE SPINS
modes.trigger: Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate this bonus game with 3 refilling lives.
modes.effects:
Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate this bonus game with 3 refilling lives.

 The following symbols appear in this bonus: dead symbols, Coins, Diamonds, Green and Gold Clovers, Heart symbols, and Magic Cauldron symbols.

 At the start of the bonus, the positions of the FS scatter symbols that activated the bonus feature will be given Grid Multipliers with x2 multipliers. Grid Multipliers are sticky and stay in place until the end of the bonus feature.

 All Coins, Diamonds and Clover symbols that land become sticky until either collected by a Magic Cauldron or the bonus feature ends.

 When a Magic Cauldron symbol lands all Grid Multipliers and Clover symbols are activated and apply their multipliers to any Coins, Diamonds or previous Magic Cauldrons in their area of effect.

 Clover symbols behave the same as in Raid Spins and have the same multiplier values (see above), and may affect any adjacent Coins, Diamonds and Magic Cauldron symbols. Grid Multipliers affect any Coins or Diamonds on the corresponding grid position.

 All Coins, Diamonds, and previous Magic Cauldron symbols are then collected into the newest Magic Cauldron, which remains on the grid until it’s collected or the feature ends. Each Magic Cauldron symbol cannot collect more than once.

 Each spin in the bonus game consumes 1 life. Whenever any symbol that is not a dead symbol lands, your lives are refilled to the maximum amount. Once all lives are consumed, the bonus will end.

 Landing a Heart symbol increases your maximum number of lives in the current bonus game by 1, up to a maximum of 5.

 At the end of the bonus feature all Coins and Diamonds on the grid reveal a random cash value depending on the symbol type. These cash values are the same as in Raid Spins (see above).

 All Grid Multipliers and Clover symbols will then activate to multiply any Coins, Diamonds, or Magic Cauldron symbols in their area of effect.

 Finally, all Coins, Diamonds and Magic Cauldron symbol values will be added together to determine the final win amount for the bonus game.

wilds.name: Magic Piggy & Magic Hat
wilds.behavior:
The Magic Piggy symbol is a revealing symbol that reveals either a Wild symbol or a Bill Stack symbol when activated by the Magic Hat symbol! All Magic Piggy symbols reveal the same type of symbol.

 When the Magic Hat symbol lands, it first shows what all Magic Piggy symbols will reveal and then transforms into the revealed symbol. 

 Bill Stack scatter symbols are cash prizes based on your current bet. All Bill Stack symbols are added together and the total amount is multiplied by your current bet to produce the win amount.

 Bill Stacks can have the following values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500

 When revealing Bill Stack symbols, there is a chance that a Magic Piggy symbol instead reveals a Multiplier Coin scatter symbol.

 Multiplier Coins reveal a multiplier value, and then multiply 1 - 5 Bill Stack symbols with the revealed value. The same Bill Stack symbol can be affected multiple times by the same Multiplier Coin, or by different Multiplier Coins.

 Multiplier Coins can have the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5

wilds.name: Epig Bonus
wilds.behavior:
Land 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to trigger this feature, which awards 10 free spins!

 In this feature the Magic Piggy symbols will only reveal Bill Stack symbols or Multiplier Coin scatter symbols when activated by the Magic Hat symbol!

 The Epig Bonus game has progressive Piggy Points that do not reset after a Magic Hat trigger! See description of Pig Bonus above for other rules.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

 Star symbols add 1 - 3 Piggy Points to the meter above the reel where it landed.

 Super Star symbols add 1 - 3 Piggy Points to all reels!

 When the Magic Hat symbol lands, an equal amount of Magic Piggy symbols will fill random positions on the corresponding reels.

 Piggy Points are reset after each Magic Hat trigger.

 Completely filling the Piggy Points meter above all reels at the same time awards 10 additional free spins!

 Landing 3 FS symbols at the same time in the feature awards 4 additional free spins.

 Landing 4 FS symbols at the same time in the feature instantly triggers the Epig Bonus. If the remaining number of free spins is less than 10, the remaining number of free spins will be set to 10. Otherwise, the current number of remaining free spins is unchanged.

scatters.name: REEL IT IN!
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus feature with 10 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.

 In this bonus feature, the Marlin Progress Bar is displayed outside the grid. Each time a Fisherman symbol lands on the grid, the Marlin Progress Bar increases by one step. This increase happens regardless of whether or not the Fisherman symbol collects any Marlin symbols that round.

 After every fourth Fisherman symbol has landed, a new upgrade level is reached:

 Upgrade 1 awards 8 additional free spins and guarantees that all subsequent Fisherman symbols land with a multiplier value of at least x2.

 Upgrade 2 awards 8 additional free spins and guarantees that all subsequent Fisherman symbols land with a multiplier value of at least x4.

 Upgrade 3 awards 8 additional free spins and guarantees that all subsequent Fisherman symbols land with a multiplier value of at least x10.

scatters.name: OFF THE HOOK!
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus feature with 15 free spins by landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.

 This bonus features the Marlin Progress Bar mechanic from REEL IT IN! but now with even better chances of reaching upgraded levels with retriggers and powerful multipliers!

scatters.name: PLENTY OF FISH IN THE SEA
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus feature with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.

 In this bonus feature, all Marlin symbols are guaranteed to have a value of at least 5x. This bonus also guarantees that at least one Marlin symbol and one Fisherman symbol will land on every spin!

multipliers.name: CATCH THEM ALL!
multipliers.behavior:
Marlin symbols are collected if 3 or more Marlin symbols land in a winning payline combination. If there is at least one Fisherman symbol on the grid, each Fisherman symbol will also collect each Marlin symbol one time.

 The Fisherman symbol can land with a multiplier value that affects the value of all the Marlin symbols that it collects. The possible multiplier values are: x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x15, x20.

 Fisherman symbols do not collect the value of other Fisherman symbols. A maximum of one Fisherman symbol can land on each reel at the same time.

collectors.name: LOOTLINES
collectors.behavior:
Marlin symbols are dynamic paying symbols that display cash values. The cash value displayed on the symbol represents the actual payout that will be awarded if the Marlin symbol is collected. Marlin symbols can have values based on the following bet multipliers: 0.5x, 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x, 1000x.

 If the value of a Marlin symbol is too large to be fully displayed, it will be shortened to 2 decimal places. The value displayed will always be the minimum amount you may be awarded. The actual awarded amount may be greater than the displayed value, but never less than the displayed value.

 For example: a value of 10,250,500 may be rounded down and displayed as 10.25M.

scatters.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - HOOKED ON PARADISE
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This Hidden Epic Bonus keeps the base game's mechanics. During this bonus, Sticky Fisherman symbols can land, collecting Marlin symbols and remaining on the grid throughout the round. 1 Sticky Fisherman symbol will be on the grid from the start. Additionally, Sticky Golden Fisherman symbols can also land. These collect both Marlin symbols and Fisherman symbols, and they stay on the grid for the duration of the bonus.

 If a Sticky Golden Fisherman symbol is on the grid, no other Golden Fisherman symbols can land. At the end of the bonus, the values collected by all Sticky Fisherman symbols are paid out. Golden Marlin symbols that land will have a minimum value of 3x.

multipliers.name: FISHERMAN SYMBOLS
multipliers.behavior:
When a Fisherman symbol lands, it collects all Marlin symbols on the grid. Each Fisherman symbol collects each Marlin symbol once and will activate top-to-bottom, left-to-right. Fisherman symbols activate after regular wins and LootLine wins have been awarded. Fisherman symbols can appear normal or Golden.

 The normal Fisherman symbols can land with a Multiplier value that affects the value of all the Marlin symbols it collects. The possible Multiplier values are: x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x15, x20. Once the Marlin symbols have been collected the Fisherman symbol will multiply the values to determine the final awarded win.

 If a Golden Fisherman symbol is on the grid, it will activate after all normal Fisherman symbols. The Golden Fisherman symbol collects all Marlin symbols on the grid and the collected values from the other Fisherman symbols on the grid. Only 1 Golden Fisherman symbol can appear at the same time.

 The total value of all Fisherman symbols on the grid is paid out at the end of the spin.

collectors.name: MARLIN SYMBOLS AND LOOTLINES
collectors.behavior:
Marlin symbols are dynamic paying symbols that display cash values and appear normal or Golden. The cash value shown on the symbol represents the payout that is awarded if the Marlin symbol is part of a LootLine or is Collected by a Fisherman. Normal and Golden Marlin symbols can have values based on the following bet Multipliers: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x, and 1000x.

 A LootLine is formed when there is a winning payline of Marlin symbols on the grid. The payout of the LootLine is determined by the values of the Marlin symbols that are part of the win. 

 When a Golden Marlin symbol is part of a LootLine win, the Golden Marlin activates and spreads its value to all normal Marlin symbols on the grid. The LootLine win is then awarded. If there are any other Golden Marlin symbols on the grid that were not part of a win, and a Fisherman symbol is present, they will then activate and spread their values to all normal Marlin symbols. Once all normal wins, LootLine wins, and Golden Marlin activations are complete, the Fisherman collects all Marlin symbols.

 If a Marlin symbol's value is too large to display fully, it will be shortened to two decimal places. The displayed value represents the minimum possible award, though the actual amount may be higher. For example, 10 250 500 may be shown as 10.25M.

scatters.behavior:

scatters.name: OFF THE HOOK!
scatters.behavior:

 Upgrade 2 awards 15 additional free spins and guarantees that all subsequent Fisherman symbols land with a multiplier value of at least x10.

scatters.name: PLENTY OF FISH IN THE SEA
scatters.behavior:

multipliers.name: CATCH THEM ALL!
multipliers.behavior:

 Fisherman symbols do not collect the value of other Fisherman symbols. A maximum of one Fisherman symbol can land on each reel at the same time.

scatters.name: STACK SPINS
scatters.behavior:
Land 3 Skull scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate this bonus feature with 10 free spins.

 In the Stack Spins feature you have a higher chance of landing Stackways™ symbols.

 Landing the Reel Activator scatter symbol activates the reel where it landed and guarantees that a Stackways™ symbol lands on that reel on each remaining free spin.

 Landing 3 Skull symbols at the same time during the feature awards 4 additional free spins.

scatters.name: MAYAN GOLD
scatters.behavior:
Land 4 Skull scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate this bonus feature.

 In the Mayan Gold feature your goal is to collect Coins and save their values above the reel where the Coins land.

 Bronze coins can have the following values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

 Silver coins can have the following values: 10, 15, 20

 Gold coins can have the following values: 25, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 500, 1000

 Landing a Multiplier symbol will multiply the number above the reel where it lands with the value on the Multiplier.

 Multipliers can have the following values: 2, 3, 4, 5

 Landing a Stackways™ symbol on a reel will fill that reel with a stack of Coins where each Coin takes on the value above that reel! Once a reel is stacked with Coins that reel is locked and no longer spins.

 Landing the Collect scatter symbol will collect all Coins on the currently locked reels and store the sum in the Vault below the reels. Collecting the Coins also unlocks the stacked reels!

 The feature ends when all five reels are simultaneously locked by stacked Coins. When the feature ends, the values of all stacked Coins and the value stored in the Vault will be added up and multiplied with your bet to determine the awarded prize.

scatters.name: A Golden Opportunity
scatters.behavior: Landing 5 Skull scatter symbols at the same time in the base game will start the Mayan Gold feature with a value of 50 above all reels. This cannot occur when buying the bonus Mayan Gold through the bonus buy feature.

specials.name: STACKWAYS™
specials.behavior:
Land the Stackways™ symbol on a reel to fill that reel with a stacked amount of paying symbols equal to the number displayed. Between 2 - 10 symbols can be stacked on each reel.

 The stacked symbol is chosen based on what symbol would create the longest winning way among the symbols present on the reels when the Stackways™ mechanic activates. If there are several symbols that would create equally long winning ways, it chooses randomly among these symbols. The stacking only occurs when the result of the stacking would create a win.

wilds.behavior:
The Mystery Mask symbol reveals either a paying symbol or a Wild symbol.

Land the Nudge Wild symbol to trigger the NUDGEREELS™ feature and nudge the Multiplier Wheel up to 50 times!

 If the Nudge Wild symbol lands with at least one winning combination on the reels it will activate the Multiplier Wheel next to the grid. The Multiplier Wheel will spin to a multiplier value that will be applied to the total of all wins on the current spin. The Nudge Wild symbol can also land with a nudge value displayed on it, in which case the Multiplier Wheel will also nudge the number of times shown on the symbol while adding all multiplier values it nudges to onto the total multiplier above the Wheel before applying the multiplier to the current total win.

 Possible nudge values on the Nudge Wild symbol: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 25, 50

wilds.name: JOLT FRAMES
wilds.behavior:
A Jolt Frame can land on a low-paying, high-paying or Wild symbol at the start of a spin and will activate after all wins have been handled on that spin. When a Jolt Frame activates, it spreads out in straight lines and turns all symbols along the lines into the same symbol type as the symbol the Jolt Frame landed on.

 A Jolt Frame can land and spread in two or four directions if there is space, vertically and horizontally, depending on the Jolt Frame that lands.

 A vertical Jolt Frame will spread from the symbol it landed on upwards and downwards to the edge of the grid.

 A horizontal Jolt Frame will spread from the symbol it landed on to the right and left edges of the grid.

 A four-way Jolt Frame will spread from the symbol it landed on upward, downward, right, and left to the edge of the grid.

 When the Jolt Frame has finished spreading, the wins will be awarded from the new Clusters that are formed. If a Jolt Frame spreads over a Wild symbol, an Additive 2x Multiplier is added to that Wild symbol. The Multiplier is then added to the Jolt Frame win. The Wild Multiplier will increase by 2x every time it is hit by a Jolt Frame. If there is more than 1 Wild Multiplier, the Multiplier values will be added and then applied to the entire win. Only 1 Jolt Frame can land at the start of a spin.

wilds.name: CHAIN REACTION
wilds.behavior: If a Jolt Frame spreads over a low-paying, high-paying, or Wild symbol of the same type as the symbol the Jolt Frame landed on, it triggers a Chain Reaction. A Jolt Frame will then appear on the second symbol, which triggers another spread depending on the Jolt Frame that lands. This Chain Reaction can continue until the grid is full.

wilds.name: WILD MYSTERY MULTIPLIERS
wilds.behavior:
Spooky Mystery Multipliers can drastically increase your winnings. Every time you get a wild symbol as part of a winning way, the wild will be replaced by a multiplier symbol. If you get several multipliers as part of a win, the multipliers shown will multiply. The multipliers will randomly take on a value of either 2, 3 or 5.

Example: If you get a win of 10 times your bet from the winning symbols and your win contains two wilds with multipliers 5 and 3, your win will be 10 * 5 * 3 = 150 times your bet! The max multiplier from this feature is 625x your win.

The wild symbol substitutes for all symbols except the BONUS and FREE SPINS symbols.

wilds.name: BURNOUT MODE
wilds.behavior:
When a Nitro symbol lands, the Burnout Mode activates. When the Burnout Mode is activated, it transforms the Nitro symbol into a Wild Nitro symbol and awards Nudges, Wild symbols and Multipliers.

 At least 5 Nudges will be added to the Nitrous Bar, located outside of the grid. The Nitrous Bar can contain up to 10 Nudges at the same time.

 There will also be 5 Wild symbols and between 0 and 3 Multipliers added to random grid positions. The Wild symbols are added randomly over regular paying symbols currently on the grid.

 When the Multipliers are added to the grid, they will be added over any Wild symbols and paying symbols on the grid, creating Position Multipliers. When a Position Multiplier is part of a winning combination, the value of the win is multiplied by the shown value. If more than one Position Multiplier is part of the same winning combination, the values are added together before being applied to the win. Multipliers can have the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x.

 Once all wins have been handled, Nudges will trigger. During Nudges, all symbols are moved down one row and new symbols drop in to fill the empty spaces. All Wild symbols and Position Multipliers are Sticky during Nudges. This means that they will remain in the same grid position as they landed and keep their Multiplier value, while regular paying symbols and Wild Nitro symbols are moved. After every Nudge, any winning combinations are awarded before the next Nudge.

 If a new Nitro symbol lands after a Nudge, at least 1 additional Nudge can be awarded to the Nitrous Bar, while 0 to 3 Wild symbols and 0 to 3 Multipliers are added to the grid. If another Multiplier is added to the same position as a Position Multiplier, the Multiplier values are added together. If a Nitro symbol lands while the Nitrous Bar already contains the maximum amount of Nudges, no new Nudges are awarded. The spin will end when the Nitrous Bar is empty.

 Only one Nitro symbol can land on the grid at the same time. W

wilds.behavior:

 This bonus game keeps the base game’s mechanics, with a Super Nitrous Bar located outside the grid. The spin guarantees that 1 Nitro symbol lands and awards between 10 and 20 Nudges.

 There is no limit for how many Nudges can be stored in the Super Nitrous Bar at the same time.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol, Wild Nitro symbol and Epic Wild Nitro symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable. Wild symbols can only appear when they are added to the grid by a Nitro symbol or when a Nitro or Epic Nitro symbol transforms into a Wild Nitro or Epic Wild Nitro symbol.

 Nitro symbols and FS symbols cannot be on the grid at the same time.

 FS symbols cannot land during the SEOUL, TOKYO or FUKUSHIMA bonuses.

wilds.name: EYE OF OTTO AND THE TENTA-GRAB MECHANIC
wilds.behavior:
The Eye of Otto symbol activates the Tenta-Grab mechanic when it lands on a grid with Ink Stains. When activated, the Tenta-Grab mechanic will randomly grab one symbol on the grid, and replace all Ink Stained positions and itself with the grabbed symbol. The Tenta-Grab mechanic can grab low symbols, high symbols, FS symbols, Wild symbols or Wild Multiplier symbols.

 If a Wild symbol or a Wild Multiplier is grabbed by the Tenta-Grab mechanic, the replacing symbols will be either Wild or Wild Multipliers with higher or lower values than the chosen symbol.

specials.name: INK STAINS
specials.behavior: When there is a win on the grid the win will be calculated, the winning symbols will be removed and new symbols will drop in to replace them. wilds.name: DUELREELS™
wilds.behavior:
When a VS symbol lands it will expand into a wild DuelReel if it would be part of or create a winning combination.

 Expanded DuelReels™ cover their entire reel and a duel will take place on each DuelReel. Each DuelReel has two multipliers, connected to the Phoenix and the Water Dragon. The surviving duelists multiplier will be applied across the entire reel and affects any winning combinations that includes the DuelReel.

 Fully expanded DuelReels™ are counted as full wild reels and substitute for all symbols in the paytable.

 The possible multiplier values that can appear on DuelReels™ are: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x, 200x.

 If more than one DuelReels™ are part of the same winning combination, their multipliers are added together before being applied to the win. 

 Only 1 VS symbol can land on a reel at a time.

specials.name: RESURRECTION SPINS
specials.behavior:
When the Phoenix loses the duel on at least one DuelReel, you will be awarded a Resurrection Spin re-spin. During this re-spin, it is guaranteed that at least 1 VS symbol will land.

 The process above will repeat during re-spins until no DuelReels™ with losing Phoenixes appear.

specials.name: BONUS GAMBLE
specials.behavior:
Whenever you enter a bonus game, you have the choice to either continue directly to the bonus game or gamble. If you choose to gamble, you will be presented with 5 Phoenix Eggs to choose from.

 You can choose up to 3 Eggs, with each Egg possibly containing 2 to 10 free spins, or a Bonus Upgrade if you are in the FIRE AND WATER bonus. If a Bonus Upgrade is found, the bonus will be immediately upgraded to the RISE OF THE PHOENIX bonus with 10 free spins.

 You may gamble once per bonus and after a Bonus Upgrade.

 The process above will repeat during re-spins until no DuelReels™ with losing Phoenixes appear.

specials.name: POWER WHEELS
specials.behavior:
When a Power Wheel lands, it will stay inactive until all payline wins have been handled. When the Power Wheel is active, the Wheel will start spinning, awarding one of the following possible Cash Prizes: 10x, 100x, 1 000x or MAX WIN. Cash Prizes are paid as a multiple of your bet.

 If more than one Power Wheel lands on the grid at the same time, the values on the Wheels will be added together. The total sum of the amount on the Wheels will then be multiplied with the current bet, resulting in the definitive win.

 When five Power Wheels land in a line on the same row, the possible Cash Prize value on each Wheel will be higher. The possible values are: 100x, 1 000x or MAX WIN.

 If a Power Wheel reveals MAX WIN, the max win will immediately be awarded and the round will end.

modes.name: HIGH-ROLLER FEATURESPINS™
modes.effects:
During the HIGH-ROLLER FEATURESPINS™, only Power Arrow symbols can land. The Power Arrows will land gradually on the five reels, with the possibility of claiming the max win.

 The Power Arrows will land in the following order:

 Five Power Arrows will land on reel 1 
 Four Power Arrows will land on reel 2 
 Three Power Arrows will land on reel 3 
 Two Power Arrows will land on reel 4 
 One Power Arrow will land on reel 5 

 When five Power Arrows land in a line on the same row, the max win of 10 000 times your bet will be awarded as a Cash Prize. If the row is broken by an empty space, that row of Power Arrows will become dead.

After the final life has been used, all Power Wheels that are currently on the grid will activate and award their combined Cash Prizes. Regular wins will be awarded after every free spin.

 If there is a full grid of Power Wheels, the bonus will end immediately when the Wheels activate and award their combined Cash Prizes.

multipliers.name: WHEEL OF SIN
multipliers.behavior:
The Wheel of Sin is positioned outside the grid. Once activated, each section of the wheel will reveal either an Adding or Multiplying value.

 The three sections of the Wheel can have the following multiplier values:

 First section, Adding Multipliers: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x, 333x

 Second section, Adding Multipliers: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x, 333x or Multiplying Multipliers: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20, x33

 Third section, Multiplying Multipliers: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20, x33

 Activate the Wheel of Sin by landing Prayer Hand or Divine Prayer Hand symbols on the grid during a win. A landed Prayer Hand symbol will reveal a number between 1- 3 which indicates how many sections on the Wheel of Sin will activate. Activated Prayer Hand symbols are removed from the grid, along with other winning symbols. As new symbols drop in, a new Prayer Hand may appear. Only one Prayer Hand symbol can appear on the grid at the same time.

 A landed Divine Prayer Hand symbol will always activate all three sections of the Wheel of Sin.

 If more than one multiplier is active on the Wheel of Sin, the multiplier values will first be combined one by one from left to right. The resulting value is then multiplied by the Total Win Bar amount to form the final payout.

wilds.behavior:
Treats are revealing wild multipliers. There are three different types of Treats: Biscuit, Bone and Steak. All winning combinations that a Treat is part of will be multiplied with the shown value. If more than one Treat is part of the same winline, their multipliers are first added together and then applied to the win.

 If you land 3 Treats of any kind anywhere on the grid on the same spin in the base game, the Treat Yo’self bonus game is awarded! The placement and type of the triggering Treats is carried over into the bonus.

 Bone can have the values: 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x

 Land additional Dawg’s Den symbols to get more spins.

wilds.name: PAY DIRECTION ARROWS AND WILD PLUS SYMBOLS
wilds.behavior:
Four Pay Direction Arrows are located outside the grid. These arrows indicate the direction in which winning paylines are calculated. The left Pay Direction Arrow is standard and is always active.

 The other arrows are activated by landing a Wild Plus symbol. Wild Plus symbols trigger immediately upon landing before any wins are awarded. A landed Wild Plus symbol activates 1-3 additional payline directions in clockwise order, starting from the top Pay Direction Arrow. Pay Direction Arrows will reset when the next spin is initiated.

 Winning paylines are awarded from one direction at a time, starting from the left and going clockwise through each activated Pay Direction.

WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 Land 5 or more connecting symbols of the same kind anywhere on the grid to get a winning combination.

 After every win the winning symbols are removed and new ones drop in. This continues until there are no more new wins on the reels.

wilds.name: Soul Orbs
wilds.behavior: The base game contains two different Soul Orbs; one red and one blue. On each new round, there is a chance of landing either one or both Soul Orbs, or neither. Both Soul Orbs are Wild symbols that absorb power from all cluster wins in a round, with stacking multipliers that are applied to any win the Soul Orbs are a part of. The multiplier on the red Soul Orb increases by 1x for each symbol in every cluster win, while the multiplier on the blue Soul Orb increases by 1x per winning cluster. The multiplier resets on every new round. If both Soul Orbs connect to a winning cluster the multipliers on the Soul Orbs multiply each other.

multipliers.name: Underworld
multipliers.behavior:
10 free spins

 In this bonus feature all paying symbols from the base game appear together with a special green Soul Orb and a multiplier modifier symbol. This feature has multipliers below each reel. Multipliers are increased when winning clusters form, increasing by 1x for each winning symbol on the corresponding reels. The multipliers can also be multiplied by the multiplier modifier symbol.
The possible values for the multiplier modifiers are: x2, x3, x4, x5 and x10.

 When the green Soul Orb symbol lands on a reel, the multiplier for that reel is activated. All activated multipliers are global. The value of all activated multipliers are added together and multiply the value of each winning cluster. Each time a multiplier is activated 3 additional spins are awarded. The maximum value per multiplier is 9999.

multipliers.name: Judgment
multipliers.behavior:
3 refilling spins

 In this bonus feature the symbols from the base game are replaced by special “block” symbols. This feature has multipliers above each reel. Multipliers are increased by landing Multiplier Modifier Blocks, which can be either adding or multiplying. There are Normal and Epic variants of both blocks, which affect either only the multiplier in the reel where they land, or all multipliers.
Adding modifiers values can be

Skull: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x and 100x
Epic Skull: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x and 100x

Multiplying modifiers values can be
Anubis Skull: x2, x3, x4, x5 and x10
Epic Anubis Skull: x2, x3, x4, x5 and x10

 When an ice block drops onto the grid, it will be crushed and a Multiplier Block will drop from the multiplier above the reel and fill the empty space. The value on each Multiplier Block is equal to the value of the reel multiplier where they drop. Multiplier Blocks fall to the bottom of the grid at the end of each drop, where they stick and stack on top of each other to gradually fill up the grid.

 There is also a special Crusher Block that falls through all other blocks to the bottom of the grid and destroys all Multiplier Blocks in its path to make room for new blocks to drop in. When the Crusher Block reaches the bottom of the grid, it transforms into a Multiplier Block with a value equal to the sum of all Multiplier Blocks that were destroyed by the Crusher Block.

 Every time a Multiplier Block, Multiplier Modifier Block or Crusher Block lands, the remaining spins reset to 3. When the bonus feature ends, the payout will equal the sum of all Multiplier Blocks times the bet level. 3 spins in a row without a Multiplier Block, Multiplier Modifier Block or Crusher Block ends the feature.

Aurora Gems can land during cascades. When an Aurora Gem lands, it activates before any wins are awarded. When activated, it will multiply all Magic Frame Multipliers on the grid. When the Aurora Gem has applied its Multiplier, it will be removed from the grid for the next cascade or spin. Only 1 Aurora Gem can land on the grid at a time.

 Possible Aurora Gem Multiplier values are: x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, x10

wilds.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - THRONE OF STARLIGHT
wilds.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This Hidden Epic Bonus game keeps the mechanics of the TIARA TREASURE bonus. Each position will have a Sticky Progressive Magic Frame Multiplier from the start! All Magic Frame Multipliers will start with a minimum value of 4x.

 FS symbols cannot land in this game mode.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

multipliers.name: MAGIC FRAME MULTIPLIERS
multipliers.behavior:
There is a chance that Magic Frame Multipliers are added to random positions during a spin or a cascade if there is at least 1 winning cluster on the grid. Magic Frame Multipliers will display an Adding Multiplier, which activates if that position is part of a winning cluster. The activated Magic Frame Multiplier is applied to the winning cluster that the Frame is part of. If more than 1 Magic Frame Multiplier is part of a winning cluster, the Multipliers will first add together, then the resulting value will be multiplied by the total win amount to form the win.

 The possible Magic Frame Multipliers values start at: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, or 100x.

 All Magic Frame Multipliers on the grid will remain in the same positions during cascades. Multiplier values will double each time they are part of a new win after the win has been awarded. The new Multiplier value will be applied to the next potential win the Magic Frame Multiplier is part of on the next cascade on that spin. When all cascades are completed and all wins have been paid out, all Magic Frame Multipliers will be removed from the grid for the next spin.

When the Aurora Gem has applied its Multiplier, it will be removed from the grid for the next cascade or spin. Only 1 Aurora Gem can land on the grid at a time.

 Possible Aurora Gem Multiplier values are: x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, x10

multipliers.name: TRIBUTE SYMBOLS AND LOOTLINES
multipliers.behavior:
Tribute symbols are dynamic multiplier symbols that award a cash prize based on the combined value of the Tribute in a LootLine, multiplied with your bet amount.

 A LootLine is formed when there is a winning payline of Tribute symbols on the grid. The payout of the LootLine will be determined by the values of the Tribute symbols that are part of the win. The Tribute symbol multipliers will be combined one by one from left to right. The resulting value is then multiplied with your bet to determine the cash prize amount.

 There are four variants of the Tribute symbols:

 Adding Tribute symbols can have the following multiplier values: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x

 Revealing Adding Tribute symbols can have the following multiplier values: 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x

 Multiplying Tribute symbols can have the following multiplier values: x2, x3, x4, x5

 Revealing Multiplying Tribute symbols can have the following multiplier values: x6, x7, x8, x9, x10, x15, x20, x25

 Adding Tribute multipliers are added to the cumulative LootLine value, while Multiplying Tribute multipliers multiply the value. Multiplying values in the left-most position on a LootLine are treated as Adding values.

 For example, a winning LootLine that consists of four Tribute symbols with the values x3, 4x, 1x and x2 will have a final payout of (3+4+1)*2=16x.

respins.how_it_works:
When the MEGAMULTIPLIER™ symbol lands while there are Ymir symbols on the grid, the multiplier values of all Ymir symbols will be added together into a global MEGAMULTIPLIER™ that applies to all wins while it is active!

 The MEGAMULTIPLIER™ also awards a respin when it activates.

 Any new Ymir symbols that land during subsequent respins will add their multiplier value to the MEGAMULTIPLIER™!

 The MEGAMULTIPLIER™ is removed at the beginning of the next round.

wilds.name: YMIR’S CONQUEST
wilds.behavior:
The Ymir symbol is a wild multiplier that substitutes for the other paying symbols in the paytable. When a Ymir symbol participates in a winning combination, the value of the win is multiplied by the shown value. If more than one Ymir symbol is part of the same winning combination, their values are first added together before being applied to the win.

 When a Ymir symbol lands, it will stick in place and be given a multiplier from one of the following values: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x

 Then, after all winning combinations on the grid have been awarded, a free respin will trigger. If any new Ymir symbols land on the respin, the process repeats. This continues until no new Ymir symbols land.

 If 4 Ymir symbols stick on the same reel, they will merge into a big Giant Ymir symbol. The multiplier values from all 4 Ymir symbols on that reel will be added together and applied to the whole Giant Ymir symbol and any winning combination it participates in.

scatters.name: DAWN OF GODS
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game has the YMIR’S CONQUEST and MEGAMULTIPLIER™ features from the base game, with a better chance of landing more Ymir symbols with higher multiplier values!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time awards extra free spins: 2 FS symbol award +2 free spins, 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.

scatters.name: FURY OF YMIR
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game has the YMIR’S CONQUEST and MEGAMULTIPLIER™ features from the base game, and the MEGAMULTIPLIER™ remains active between spins until the end of the bonus once activated!

 The multiplier on any new Ymir symbols that land while the MEGAMULTIPLIER™ is active will be collected in the global multiplier and applied to all wins!

 There is also a better chance of landing more Ymir symbols with higher multiplier values.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time awards extra free spins: 2 FS symbol award +2 free spins, 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.

scatters.name: FALL OF YMIR
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 3 refilling lives by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game has only the following symbols: non-paying “dead symbols”, Volcanic Ymir symbol, MEGAMULTIPLIER™ symbol, and Asgardian Orb symbols.

 The following symbols are dead symbols:

 Each spin in the bonus consumes 1 life. Whenever any symbol other than one of the dead symbols lands, your lives are refilled to 3. After 3 spins without a refill, the bonus will end.

 The Volcanic Ymir symbol is a special multiplier symbol that can be collected and increased in different ways!

 When a Volcanic Ymir symbol lands, it will stick in place and be given a multiplier from one of the following values: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x

 When a MEGAMULTIPLIER™ symbol lands, all Volcanic Ymir symbol multipliers values are added to a total global multiplier, while the Volcanic Ymir symbols also retain their values on the grid.

 When an Asgardian Orb symbol lands the collected value in the global multiplier is consumed and added to some or all of the Volcanic Ymir symbols.

 Green Asgardian Orb symbols add the value to all Volcanic Ymir symbols on the reel where it landed. If there are no Volcanic Ymir symbols on that reel, nothing happens.

 Golden Asgardian Orb symbols add the value to ALL Volcanic Ymir symbols on the whole grid!

 When the collected global multiplier is consumed in this way, its value is reset to 0 and removed. Land new MEGAMULTIPLIER™ symbols to build it back up again!

 Once the bonus game ends, the value of all Volcanic Ymir symbols on the grid will be added together and multiplied by your bet to determine the final win!

multipliers.name: MULTIPLIER ROCKETS
multipliers.behavior:
This game features launching ROCKETS that ascend through the reel and destroy any symbols they pass through. The ROCKETS then leave a trail of MULTIPLIERS on all symbol positions! When new symbols drop you have a chance to overlay a MULTIPLIER on a winning cluster and multiply your win.

If you land more than one MULTIPLIER on the same winning cluster, the multipliers will first be added together and the win will then be multiplied by the total multiplier value.

There can be only one ROCKET on each reel per spin. In the base game three or more ROCKETS are required to trigger a ROCKET launch and in the Free Spins feature all landed rockets will launch.

There are three types of rockets with different multiplier values

 ROCKET 1

Possible multiplier values: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x

 ROCKET 2

Possible multiplier values: 10x, 15x, 20x

 ROCKET 3

Possible multiplier values: 25x, 50x, 75x

The UFO can appear both in the base game and in the Free spins feature.

wilds.name: ALMOST STICKY WILD POSTERS
wilds.behavior:
Wild Posters can land with Hearts, a Multiplier, or both! They will stay on the grid and give respins as long as at least one Heart remains.

 Each Wild Poster can land with up to 3 Hearts and loses one Heart per respin. Once no Hearts are left, the Wild Poster will be removed on the next respin.

 Wild Posters can also land with a random multiplier from one of the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x. If more than one Wild Poster with multipliers participates in a winning combination, their multipliers are added together before being applied to the win.

 All landed FS symbols will be collected in the progress bar above the grid during the respins. If you manage to collect 3 or 4, you get a bonus!

wilds.name: WHO SHOT THE SHERIFF?
wilds.behavior:
When the bullets start flying, what’s the best thing to do? Shoot more, of course! Get 4 FS scatter symbols during one spin in the base game to activate the WHO SHOT THE SHERIFF? bonus feature with 12 free spins divided in 3 Cycles!

 This bonus feature consists of a Collect Phase and a Payout Phase which together make up one “Cycle” that consists of 1 Collect Phase spin and 3 Payout Phase spins.

 In the Collect Phase either Rusty, Curly or both of them will land and expand to a Wild Reel on a random reel. They will then both shoot 1 to 6 times at the Multipliers that appear on the grid. The total value of the Multipliers they shoot at will be added to that Wild Reel in the Payout Phase. The available Multiplier values are: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x. If more than one Wild Reel with multipliers participates in a winning combination, their multipliers are added together before being applied to the win.

 The Payout Phase consists of 3 spins with paying symbols. The Rusty & Curly Wild Reels are sticky with Multiplier values carried over from the Collect Phase. After 3 Payout Phase spins the game will go back to the Collect Phase again.

 During the Payout Phase, Crispy & Chewy symbols can also land and expand to Wild Reels, but will not have any multipliers. Crispy & Chewy Wild Reels are not sticky.

 Landing additional FS symbols in the feature at the same time awards additional Cycles: Landing 1 FS symbol awards 1 additional Cycle, Landing 2 FS symbols awards 2 additional Cycles, Landing 3 FS symbols awards 3 additional Cycles.

respins.how_it_works:
During a respin, there is a chance that a Sandstorm will be activated before any new symbols land on the grid.

 When a Sandstorm is active, no new symbols will land and the Sandstorm nudges all Wild Scarab Multipliers one reel to the left. Once the Wild Scarab Multipliers have been nudged, new symbols will land and the grid will settle. After the grid has settled, any new payline wins will be rewarded.

 Wild Scarab Multipliers cannot be nudged if they are located on the leftmost reel, or if the Wild Scarab Multipliers on the adjacent reel on the same row are blocked.

 Firestorms and Sandstorms cannot be activated during the same respin.

wilds.name: FIRESTORMS
wilds.behavior:
During a respin, there is a chance that a Firestorm will be activated before any new symbols land on the grid. When a Firestorm is active, no new symbols will land and the Firestorm will randomly increase the Multiplier value of all the Wild Scarab Multipliers by adding one of the following Multiplier values to the existing Multipliers: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 Once the Wild Scarab Multipliers have been increased, new symbols will land on the grid and any new payline wins will be rewarded. The Multiplier values of Wild Scarab Multipliers can continue to increase until they reach 999x.

modes.name: WILD SCARAB MULTIPLIERS AND RESPINS
modes.trigger: After all regular wins have been handled, the landed Wild Scarab Multipliers will trigger a respin.
modes.effects:
The Wild Scarab Multiplier acts as a Wild, substituting for all paying symbols in the paytable. When a Wild Scarab Multiplier lands on the grid, it will have a Multiplier value. The Multiplier value of the Wild Scarab Multiplier will be applied to all wins that the symbol is part of.

 If a winning payline includes more than one Wild Scarab Multiplier, the Multiplier values are added together before being applied to the win. Wild Scarab Multipliers will land on the grid with one of the following additive Multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x.

 After all regular wins have been handled, the landed Wild Scarab Multipliers will trigger a respin. During the respin, the Wild Scarab Multiplier will remain in the same grid position as it landed, while new symbols will spin in. If any new Wild Scarab Multiplier lands during a respin, a new respin will be triggered. The respins will continue until no new Wild Scarab Multipliers land or if there are no more available positions. Any new payline wins will be rewarded at the end of every respin.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

multipliers.name: COLORED FRAMES
multipliers.behavior:
Colored Frames will land on positions during a spin and reveal a Multiplier or a Jackpot when the grid settles. A Colored Frame counts as part of a win if the symbol in its position is included in a winning payline. When a Multiplier Frame is part of a win, the win is multiplied by the value of the Multiplier. If there is more than one Multiplier in a win, the Multiplier values will be added together to form a total, which is applied to the win.

 Possible Multiplier values are: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 Jackpot Frames award one of four different cash prizes when part of a win or when collected by a Collector Symbol. The Jackpot value is based on your current bet. When a Jackpot is part of a win, the win is multiplied by your bet to determine the total awarded amount. If more than 1 Jackpot is part of a win, all Jackpot values will be added together to determine the total awarded amount. After the wins are awarded, any Multiplier Frame or Jackpot Frame will be removed from the grid for the next spin.

 The four Jackpots are:

 MINI: 25x

 MAJOR: 100x

 MEGA: 500x

 MAX WIN: 20 000x

 The current value of each Jackpot is displayed outside the grid on the Jackpot Board.

multipliers.name: COLLECTOR SYMBOLS
multipliers.behavior: The Collector Symbol collects the values of all Multipliers and Jackpots that land during a spin, even if they don't form a winning combination. The collected total Multiplier and Jackpot value is multiplied by your current bet amount after all wins have been paid out. Only 1 Collector Symbol can land at a time. Collector Symbols cannot land in a Colored Frame.

features.effects:
Colored Frames will land on positions during a spin and reveal a Multiplier or a Jackpot when the grid settles. A Colored Frame counts as part of a win if the symbol in its position is included in a winning payline. When a Multiplier Frame is part of a win, the win is multiplied by the value of the Multiplier.  Possible Multiplier values are: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 Jackpot Frames award one of four different cash prizes when part of a win or when collected by a Collector Symbol. The Jackpot value is based on your current bet. When a Jackpot is part of a win, the win is multiplied by your bet to determine the total awarded amount. If more than 1 Jackpot is part of a win, all Jackpot values will be added together to determine the total awarded amount. After the wins are awarded, any Multiplier Frame or Jackpot Frame will be removed from the grid for the next spin.

 The four Jackpots are:

 MINI: 25x

 MAJOR: 100x

 MEGA: 500x

 MAX WIN: 20 000x

 The current value of each Jackpot is displayed outside the grid on the Jackpot Board.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
Chi Orbs are wild multiplier symbols that have a chance to land on the grid. When a Chi Orb symbol is part of a winning combination the multiplier on the Chi Orb will multiply the value of the cluster win. 

 There are three types of Chi Orb multiplier symbols:

 Blue Chi Orb: Will land with a multiplier value of 1x and increase by +1 after every time it has been a part of a cluster win.

 Red Chi Orb: Will land with a multiplier value of 1x and increase after every time it is a part of a win, increasing by +1 for each symbol that was a part of the winning cluster (including any Chi Orbs).

 Balance Chi Orb: This Chi Orb appears only on cascades. When it appears it will land with a multiplier value that is the product of any Red and Blue Chi Orb multipliers on the grid. If it is a part of a win, it will apply its multiplier value to the win, and then disappear from the grid together with the other winning symbols. 

 If multiple Chi Orbs are a part of the same win, the values of all the Chi Orbs in that win will be multiplied with each other before being applied to the win. 

 Blue and Red Chi Orbs are not removed together with the symbols of winning clusters during cascades, but are persistent until the end of the round. At the end of each round, all Chi Orbs are removed from the grid.

scatters.name: THE STUDENT
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus feature with 10 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game. Activate this bonus feature with 12 free spins by landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 In this bonus feature all paying symbols from the base game can reappear together with a special Green Chi Orb and a Green Gem multiplier modifier symbol.

 This feature has multipliers below each reel. Multipliers are increased when winning clusters form, increasing by 1x for each winning symbol on the corresponding reels. The multipliers can also be multiplied by the Green Gem multiplier modifier symbol. The possible values for the Green Gem multiplier modifiers are: x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9 and x10.

 When the Green Chi Orb symbol lands on a reel, the multiplier for that reel is activated. All activated multipliers are global. The value of all activated multipliers are added together and multiply the value of each winning cluster. Each time a multiplier is activated 3 additional spins are awarded. A maximum of one Green Chi Orb can land per reel. The max value per multiplier is 9999x.

scatters.name: THE MASTER
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus feature with 3 refilling lives by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 In this bonus feature the symbols from the base game are replaced by special Stone block symbols.

 This feature has multipliers above each reel. Multipliers are increased by landing Multiplier Modifier Blocks, which can be either adding or multiplying. There are Normal and Epic variants of both blocks, which affect either only the multiplier in the reel where they land, or all multipliers. The max value per multiplier on a reel is 9999x.

 Adding modifier block values can be:

 Blue Gem: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x

 Epic Blue Gem: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x

 Multiplying modifier block values can be:

 Green Gem: x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, x10

 Epic Green Gem: x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, x10

 When an Ice block drops onto the grid, it will be crushed and a Multiplier Block will drop from the multiplier above the reel and fill the empty space. The value on each Multiplier Block is equal to the value of the reel multiplier where they drop. Multiplier Blocks fall to the bottom of the grid at the end of each drop, where they stick and stack on top of each other to gradually fill up the grid.

 There is also a special Crusher Block that falls through all other blocks to the bottom of the grid and destroys all Multiplier Blocks in its path to make room for new blocks to drop in. When the Crusher Block reaches the bottom of the grid, it transforms into a Multiplier Block with a value equal to the sum of all Multiplier Blocks that were destroyed by the Crusher Block.

 Every time a Multiplier Block, Multiplier Modifier Block or Crusher Block lands, the remaining spins reset to 3. When the bonus feature ends, the payout will equal the sum of all Multiplier Blocks times the bet level. 3 spins in a row without a Multiplier Block, Multiplier Modifier Block or Crusher Block ends the feature.

wilds.name: SNOW-VOLVER SYMBOL
wilds.behavior:
Normal and Epic Snow-volver symbols can land with 1 - 6 Snowballs. When a Snow-volver lands, the shown number of Snowballs are thrown at random positions on the grid.

 When a position without Snow is hit for the first time by a Normal Snowball it sticks to the grid and turns into a Wild Snow symbol. When a Snow symbol is hit by another Snowball, a random multiplier is added to the Snow and turns it into a Wild Snow Multiplier.

 When any position is hit by an Epic Snowball it immediately becomes a Snow Multiplier!

 The possible multiplier values that each Snowball can add to a Snow Multiplier are: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x.

 If more than one Snow Multiplier is part of the same winning combination, their multiplier values are added together before being applied to the win.

 Subsequent hits on existing Snow Multipliers increases the multiplier value.

 In the base game and YOU REAP WHAT YOU SNOW bonus, Epic Snow-volvers always activate before Normal Snow-volvers to maximize the chances of stacking more multipliers on each Snow Multiplier.

 Once a Snow-volver is empty, it is replaced by a WILD symbol.

modes.name: THROW SNOW! BONUS FEATURE
modes.trigger: Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the THROW SNOW! bonus feature.
modes.effects:
Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the THROW SNOW! bonus feature.

 When entering this bonus, the game transforms and only Snow-volver symbols, Reload symbols and non-paying symbols will appear on the reels!

 The bonus has 3 refilling lives that reset each time any Snow-volver or Reload symbol lands. Each life represents one spin. Once all 3 lives are consumed without a new reset, the bonus feature ends. If all positions on the grid are filled with used Snow-volver symbols, the feature will end immediately.

 There are six Gift Boxes with multiplier values displayed above the grid. Gift Boxes can have either multiplying or adding multipliers:

 Possible values for adding multipliers are: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 30x, 40x, 50x, 75x, 100x, 150x, 200x, 250x, 500x

 Possible values for multiplying multipliers are: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20

 In this bonus, when a Snow-volver lands the shown number of Snowballs are thrown at random Gift Boxes instead of onto the grid. When a Snowball hits a Gift Box, its multiplier value is added or multiplied to the Snow-volver’s total value.

 Normal Snow-volvers stick to the grid and keep their multiplier value until the end of the feature.

 Epic Snow-volver total multipliers are added to all existing sticky Normal Snow-volvers and Reload symbols that are present on the grid. All Epic Snow-volvers then disappear on the next spin.

 In this bonus Epic Snow-volvers always activate after Normal Snow-volvers and Reload symbols, to maximize the possible multiplier values that are added to the existing symbols.

 The Reload symbol reloads Normal Snow-volvers so you can collect more multiplier values!

 Landed Reload symbols activate after newly landed Normal Snow-volvers. When a Reload symbol activates it collects all the multipliers from all the sticky Normal Snow-volvers on the reel and reloads the Normal Snow-volvers with 1 - 6 new Snowballs. These Snowballs are then immediately thrown at the Gift Boxes, and the collected values are added to the Normal Snow-volvers. Reload symbols also stick to the grid and keep their collected multipliers until the end of the feature.

 At the end of the bonus feature all sticky Normal Snow-volver and Reload symbol multiplier values are added together and multiplied by your bet to give you the final win!

wilds.behavior:
When a Spinman symbol lands it expands into a Wild Justice Reel if the expanded symbol is a part of at least one winning combination once expanded.

multipliers.name: Multipliers
multipliers.behavior: In the base game, non-winning symbols are removed after every win, and all winning symbols are kept and are dropped to the bottom of the grid. Below each reel, a value is shown indicating the number of winning stacked symbols in that reel. All winning clusters will be multiplied with the total of the multiplier values they are above. For example, if a winning cluster is above 1x, 3x and 2x, those multipliers will first be added together to a total of 6x, which will then be multiplied with the winning cluster amount. This process continues as long as you stack more wins.

modes.name: Freespins
modes.trigger: Get at least three free spin scatter symbols in the base game to trigger the free spin feature.
modes.effects:
Get at least three free spin scatter symbols in the base game to trigger the free spin feature. You are initially awarded 5 free spins, displayed as hearts above the reels. The free spins mode continues until no more hearts remain. In free spins, all symbols are removed between each spin. Every time you hit a win in the free spins mode, the total multiplier will be increased by the number of winnings symbols.
Example: If a winning cluster consists of 6 symbols, 6 will be added to the total.

On each free spin there is a chance that the special X symbol appears. All winning clusters that connect with this symbol will be multiplied with the factor shown above the reels.

The ? symbol will give you additional spins or increase your multiplier. The following outcomes are possible:

- 2-5 additional lives
- Add one of the following to the total multiplier: 1, 2, 5, 10, 25 or 50
- Multiply the total multiplier by 2, 3, 4 or 5

 Special Symbols

 The wild symbol substitutes for all paying symbols.

wilds.name: WILD GAS CANISTER SYMBOLS
wilds.behavior:
When a Green Gas Canister symbol lands, it spreads and transforms itself along with all adjacent low-paying and Wild symbols into Wild symbols. The spread occurs horizontally and vertically, if the transformed symbols will be part of a win. If additional low-paying or Wild symbols are connected to the newly transformed ones, the spread continues, turning those connected symbols into Wilds as well.

 When a Purple Gas Canister symbol lands, it will spread and transform itself and all low-paying and Wild symbols on the grid into Wild symbols if the transformed symbols will be part of a win.

 When low-paying symbols are transformed into Wild symbols, there is a chance that a random Multiplier value is added to that new Wild symbol. Wild symbols created by Gas Canisters can have the following Additive Multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x, 200x. Wild symbols already on the grid that are affected by Gas Canister symbols will receive a 2x Multiplier value.

 When a Wild symbol with a Multiplier participates in a winning combination, the value of the win is multiplied by the Wild Multiplier value. If more than one Wild Multiplier is part of the same winning combination, their values are added before being applied to the win. The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable. Only 1 Gas Canister symbol can land on the grid at a time.

modes.name: THUNDER RESPINS
modes.trigger: Land at least 5 Coin symbols of any kind at the same time to trigger the Thunder Respins.
modes.effects:
Land at least 5 Coin symbols of any kind at the same time to trigger the Thunder Respins. This Respin sequence contains only dead symbols, Coins, and Collector Chests. During Thunder Respins, all Coins and Collector Chests that land are sticky until the Respin sequence ends. Dead symbols are non-paying and have no other effect.

 Continue to land Coin symbols of any kind or Collector Chests to continue the Thunder Respins. When no new Coin symbols or Collector Chests land, the Respin sequence will end. At the end of the Thunder Respins, all Coins on the grid reveal a random cash value depending on the Coin symbol. The revealed values are calculated based on your current bet.

 Bronze Coins can reveal values based on the following bet multipliers: 0.5x, 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x

 Silver Coins can reveal values based on the following bet multipliers: 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x

 Gold Coins can reveal values based on the following bet multipliers: 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x, 250x, 500x

 The Collector Chest symbols can land with or without a Multiplier. After all Coin symbols reveal their cash values, the Collector Chest activates and collects all Coin symbols on the grid. If a Collector Chest lands with a Multiplier, it first collects the Coin symbols, then reveals the Multiplier value and applies it to the Coin totals to determine the final amount.

 If more than 1 Collector Chest lands, each one will apply its own Multiplier to the Coin symbols it collected. Each Collector Chest collects each Coin symbol once. If Coin symbols get collected, they will retain their original values when collected by another Collector Chest. Collector Chests activate one by one, from top to bottom, left to right. The final win is the total value of all collected Coins from all Collector Chests. The possible Multiplier values are: x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x15, x20

 Once the Thunder Respin sequence ends and all collections are complete, the grid resets, removing Coin symbols, Collector Chests, and dead symbols before the next spin.

If more than 1 Wild symbol contributes to a win, their values are added together before being applied to the total win.

 If 4 Wild symbols land and cover an entire reel, they transform into a full Wild God Reel with a total Multiplier. This total Multiplier is the sum of adding all individual Wild Multiplier values and is applied to the entire Wild God Reel. If a winning combination includes more than 1 Wild God Reel, the Multiplier values will first be added from left to right and then applied to the win. Wild God Reels stick to the grid and remain throughout the bonus.

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins,

wilds.name: PORTALS TO MUSPELHEIM
wilds.behavior:
When the Hand of Surtur scatter symbol lands and activates it rips downward to the bottom of the reel and creates a Portal to Muspelheim! Portals act as wild symbols and substitutes for all other paying symbols. The Hand of Surtur symbol only activates if the created Portal would be part of or create at least one winning combination.

 If the Hand of Surtur rips through a WILD symbol it will reveal a multiplier value that is applied to the whole Portal and affects any winning lines that pass through it.

 The possible Portal multiplier values are: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x

 If a winning line is affected by more than one multiplier, the multipliers will first be added together and then applied to the win.

 If the Hand of Surtur rips through a Treasure Chest symbol it will shatter and award its contents as an extra cash prize!

 The possible Treasure Chest cash prizes values are: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 50, 75, 100, 150, 200, 250, 500, 750, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500 times your bet.

 If the Hand of Surtur rips through both a WILD and a Treasure Chest at the same time, the multiplier from the WILD will also be applied to the cash prize from the Treasure Chest.

modes.effects:

 3 Surtur symbols award 10 free spins.
4 Surtur symbols award 12 free spins.
5 Surtur symbols award 14 free spins.

 The first WILD symbol that lands on each reel will become sticky until the end of the bonus. If any WILD symbols were present on the reels when the bonus feature was awarded, they will be carried over from the base game into the bonus and become sticky.

 There can be only one sticky WILD symbol on each reel. If a reel already has a sticky WILD symbol, no additional WILD symbols will appear on that reel.

 When the Frost Sword scatter symbol activates it will trigger a Portal to Midgard and an icy sword will slice downward to the bottom of the reel, breaking any WILD symbols or Treasure Chests in its path. See the section Portal to Muspelheim above for more details. The Frost Sword symbol only activates if the created Portal would be part of or create at least one winning combination.

 Landing additional Surtur symbols simultaneously in the bonus feature will award extra free spins:

 2 Surtur symbols award 2 extra free spins.
3 Surtur symbols award 4 extra free spins.
4 Surtur symbols award 6 extra free spins.
5 Surtur symbols award 8 extra free spins.

modes.name: WARRIORS OF THE STORM BONUS FEATURE
modes.effects:
Get at least 3 Viking scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate this bonus feature!

 3 Viking symbols award 10 free spins.
4 Viking symbols award 12 free spins.
5 Viking symbols award 14 free spins.

 When the Hammer of Thor scatter symbol lands it will forge the reel it landed on into a Storm Reel that persists until the end of the bonus feature! Storm Reels are full wild reels and substitutes for all other paying symbols.

 On each spin, all Storm Reels will reveal either a Viking Warrior or be filled with a raging STORM.

 Three different warriors can appear in each Storm Reel, revealing a multiplier value that is applied to the whole Storm Reel and affects any winning lines that pass through it. If a winning line is affected by more than one multiplier, the multipliers will first be added together and then applied to the win.

 The Rogue can have the following multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x

 The Shieldmaiden can have the following multiplier values: 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x

 The Berserker can have the following multiplier values: 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x

 When a Storm Reel is filled with a STORM it will be only wild during the current spin, then move one step to the left at the start of the next free spin. The moving Storm Reel will also push other Storm Reels in its way to the left. The reels will not move if there is no empty space to the left that they can move into.

 Landing additional Viking symbols simultaneously in the bonus feature will award extra free spins:

5 Viking symbols award 8 extra free spins.

wilds.name: ROTOGRID™
wilds.behavior:
Landed RotoGrid™ symbols are activated after wins on the current grid have been awarded, giving 1 - 3 clockwise grid rotations that are collected and stored in a meter outside the grid. The RotoGrid™ symbol will then turn into a Wild symbol.

 Each grid rotation turns the grid a quarter turn clockwise and unlocks the possibility of new wins being created on the grid. Each rotation is awarded one at a time, processing any new wins before the next rotation.

 If multiple RotoGrid™ symbols are present on the grid at the same time, they will be activated one at a time, after all rotations from the previously activated RotoGrid™ symbol have been completed. Maximum 3 RotoGrid™ symbols can land on the same spin.

modes.effects:
When you choose this bonus game from the Bonus Choice menu, you will get 8 free spins.

 The following symbols appear in this bonus: Skull Block symbols, Cracked Stone symbols, FS symbols and Adding and Multiplying Coin symbols. Skull Block symbols and Cracked Stone symbols are non-paying.

 The aim of the bonus is to collect Coin and FS symbols in the Treasure Chests at the bottom of the grid.

 When a Coin or FS symbol lands above a Cracked Stone symbol, that Stone symbol will be crushed and disappear from the grid, letting the Coin or FS symbol move down into its position. This process repeats until a Skull Block symbol gets in the way, or the Coin or FS symbol reaches the bottom row of the grid. Whenever a Coin or FS symbol reaches the bottom row, they will be collected in the Treasure Chest for the corresponding reel.

 Each Treasure Chest has a progressive multiplier which is paid out at the end of the bonus and multiplied with your bet amount to determine the final win. Collected Coin symbols either add their value to the existing value on the Treasure Chest, or multiply the existing value on the Treasure Chest. All Treasure Chests start at 0x.

 Adding Coins can have the following values: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x

 Multiplying Coins can have the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20

 Collected FS symbols each award 1 extra free spin.

 Once all Coin and FS symbols on the grid have moved as far as they can, there is a chance that the grid will rotate either clockwise or counter-clockwise. When the grid rotates, it may allow Coin symbols and FS symbols to move to a new position by breaking Cracked Stone symbols, leading them through the “labyrinth” of Skull Block symbols towards the bottom of the grid.

 If the Might of Hercules feature triggers in this bonus game, a random number of Skull Block symbols will be destroyed and sometimes a random number of Cracked Stone symbols will be destroyed. If Skull Block symbols or Cracked Stone symbols are destroyed, additional FS or Coin symbols may appear on the grid.

modes.name: GODLY LABYRINTH BONUS GAME
modes.effects:

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

 Wild symbols cannot replace FS symbols when spreading between connected Wilds.

wilds.name: SUN RAY FRAMES
wilds.behavior:
A Sun Ray Frame can land on a low-paying, high-paying, or Wild symbol at the start of a spin and will activate after all wins have been handled on that spin. When a Sun Ray Frame activates, it spreads out in straight lines and turns all symbols along the lines into the same symbol type as the symbol the Sun Ray landed on. 

 A Sun Ray Frame can land and spread in two or four directions if there is space, vertically and horizontally, depending on the Sun Ray Frame that lands.

 A vertical Sun Ray Frame will spread from the symbol it landed on upwards and downwards to the edge of the grid.

 A horizontal Sun Ray Frame will spread from the symbol it landed on to the right and left edges of the grid.

 A four-way Sun Ray Frame will spread from the symbol it landed on upward, downward, right, and left to the edge of the grid.

 When the Sun Ray has finished spreading, the wins will be awarded from the new Clusters that are formed. If a Sun Ray Frame spreads over a Wild symbol, an additive 2x Multiplier is added to that Wild symbol. The Multiplier is then added to the Sun Ray win. The Wild Multiplier will increase by 2x every time it is hit by a Sun Ray Frame. If there is more than 1 Wild Multiplier, the Multiplier values will be added and then applied to the entire win. Only 1 Sun Ray Frame can land at the start of a spin.

wilds.name: CHAIN REACTION
wilds.behavior: If a Sun Ray Frame spreads over a low-paying, high-paying, or Wild symbol of the same type as the symbol the Sun Ray landed on, it triggers a Chain Reaction. A Sun Ray Frame will then appear on the second symbol, which triggers another spread depending on the Sun Ray Frame that lands. This Chain Reaction can continue until the grid is full.

collectors.name: RED ORB SYMBOLS AND HOLD & WIN SEQUENCES
collectors.behavior:
When a Red Orb symbol lands, it triggers a Hold & Win sequence after any regular wins have been handled. The Hold & Win sequence starts with 3 refilling lives that represent 3 spins.

 During the Hold & Win sequence, only Red Orb, Jackpot, Dead symbols and Bronze, Silver, Gold or Diamond Coins will land. Every time a Red Orb, Coin or Jackpot symbol lands, the lives are refilled and new spins are awarded. Dead symbols are non-paying symbols and have no other effect.

 When Red Orb, Coin and Jackpot symbols land, they stick to the grid. All Coins are cash prizes that are paid as a multiple of your bet. Coin symbols award wins when they are collected by Orb symbols.

 Bronze Coins can have the following values: 0.2x, 0.4x, 1x, 2x 
 Silver Coins can have the following values: 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x 
 Gold Coins can have the following values: 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x 
 Diamond Coins can have the following values: 100x, 150x, 200x, 250x, 500x, 1000x 

 After the final life has been used or there are no available positions on the grid, any Jackpot symbols will reveal their values from the Jackpot sign outside of the grid. Only one Jackpot symbol can land at the same time during a spin. Jackpot symbols award wins when they are collected by Orb symbols. Jackpot values revealed from the Jackpot sign are awarded as a multiple of your bet. Jackpot symbols can reveal the following values from the Jackpot sign:

 Mini: 10x 
 Major: 50x 
 Mega: 500x

collectors.name: BLUE ORB SYMBOLS
collectors.behavior:
When a Blue Orb symbol lands, any regular wins are handled before the Blue Orb is activated. When activated, Blue Orb symbols collect the values from all Coin and Jackpot symbols on the grid and the sum is paid out as a multiple of your bet.

 When there are multiple Blue Orb symbols on the grid, each Blue Orb symbol collects the values of each Coin and Jackpot symbol once. The values collected by each Blue Orb symbol are then added together and the sum is paid out as a multiple of your bet. Blue Orb symbols collect from left to right, top to bottom.

 3 Blue Orb symbols can land during the same spin. Red and Blue Orb symbols cannot be on the grid at the same time.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
Activate the Cascade Counter by landing a Lightning symbol and a win on the same spin. When activated, all non-winning symbols that are removed through Super Cascades are collected and the collected symbols are converted into a Multiplier value. Each collected low-paying symbol adds a 1x Additive Multiplier per winning cluster, and each collected high-paying symbol adds a 2x Additive Multiplier per winning cluster, which is visible in the Total Win Bar. The Cascade Counter stays active until the end of the spin.

 When all wins and Super Cascades have been handled on that spin, the final collected win will be multiplied by the Multiplier value from the Cascade Counter in the Total Win Bar to determine the payout for that spin.

 If an Epic Lightning symbol lands and there is a win in the Total Win Bar, the total win is multiplied by an additional Multiplier value at the end of the spin. Epic Lightning symbols can have the following Multiplicative Multipliers x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, x10, x25, x50, x77, x100. Only 1 Epic Lightning symbol can land on each spin.

 If 6 FS scatter symbols land at the same time, a Max Win is awarded instantly.

scatters.behavior:
Activate the Cascade Counter by landing a Lightning symbol and a win on the same spin. When activated, all non-winning symbols that are removed through Super Cascades are collected and the collected symbols are converted into a Multiplier value. Each collected low-paying symbol adds a 1x Additive Multiplier per winning cluster, and each collected high-paying symbol adds a 2x Additive Multiplier per winning cluster, which is visible in the Total Win Bar. The Cascade Counter stays active until the end of the spin.

 When all wins and Super Cascades have been handled on that spin, the final collected win will be multiplied by the Multiplier value from the Cascade Counter in the Total Win Bar to determine the payout for that spin.

 If an Epic Lightning symbol lands and there is a win in the Total Win Bar, the total win is multiplied by an additional Multiplier value at the end of the spin. Epic Lightning symbols can have the following Multiplicative Multipliers x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, x10, x25, x50, x77, x100. Only 1 Epic Lightning symbol can land on each spin.

 If 6 FS scatter symbols land at the same time, a Max Win is awarded instantly.

specials.name: COINWAYS™
specials.behavior:
When Bronze, Silver or Gold Coin symbols land in a formation that is equivalent to one of the predetermined Ways to win, CoinWays™ are formed. CoinWays™ must start at the leftmost reel and include Coin symbols on at least 3 adjacent reels. If there are Coins on reels 1, 2, 3 and 5, the CoinWays™ will only include the Coin values of the first 3 reels. CoinWays™ are activated after regular wins have been handled.

 Bronze Coins can have the following values: 1x 
 Silver Coins can have the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x 
 Gold Coins can have the following values: 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x 

 When CoinWays™ activate, the Coin symbols add their values to the Coin Bar value for the reel they land on. Each reel’s Coin value will be displayed in the Coin Bar located outside of the grid. If there are multiple Coins on a reel, the Coin values are added together to determine the total Coin value of the reel.

 Once the Coin symbol values have been added to the Coin Bar, the values in the Coin Bar will be multiplied from left to right. For example, if values in the Coin Bar are 2, 3, 2, 7, 3, the final CoinWays™ value will be 2x3x2x7x3=252x. The CoinWays™ value will be awarded as a cash prize that is multiplied by your bet to determine the final win. The Coin Bar will reset before the next spin.

 Coin symbols can only land in the THUNDER REIGN, WRATH OF OLYMPUS and LAST ASCENSION bonuses.

 Coin symbols can also land in SACRED FEATURESPINS™.

wilds.name: The Toad & the Pot
wilds.behavior:
The Toad symbol is a revealing symbol that reveals either a Wild symbol or a Gold Coins symbol when activated by the Prosperity Pot symbol! All Toad symbols reveal the same type of symbol.

 When the Prosperity Pot symbol lands, it first shows what all Toad symbols will reveal and then transforms into the revealed symbol.

 Gold Coins scatter symbols are cash prizes based on your current bet. All Gold Coins symbols are added together and the total amount is multiplied by your current bet to produce the win amount.

 Gold Coins can have the following values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 50, 75, 100, 250, 500, 750, 1000

 When revealing Gold Coins symbols, there is a chance that a Toad symbol instead reveals a Coin Bag scatter symbol.

 Coin Bag symbols reveal a multiplier value, and then multiply 1 - 5 Gold Coins symbols with the revealed value. The same Gold Coins pile symbol can be affected multiple times by the same Coin Bag, or by different Coin Bags.

 Coin Bags can have the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5
